question_sw: PAYE ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) ni kodi ya mapato inayokatwa na mwajiri kutoka kwa mishahara ya wafanyakazi kila mwezi, kisha kulipwa TRA. Mwajiri ni wakala wa makusanyo — analipa kodi kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) is income tax withheld by an employer from employees' monthly wages and remitted to TRA. The employer is the collection agent — paying tax on behalf of the employee. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE TRA lini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE kabla ya kuanza kulipa mshahara wa kwanza wa mfanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS kwenye tovuti ya TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must an employer register for PAYE with TRA?
answer_en: An employer must register for PAYE before paying the first employee's salary. Registration is done through the IDRAS system on the TRA website. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa PAYE TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: PAYE lazima ilipwe TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano, PAYE ya Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the PAYE remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE must be remitted to TRA by the 7th of the following month. For example, January PAYE is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Malipo gani yanastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE inakata: mshahara wa msingi, ujira wa ziada (overtime), posho (allowances — nyumba, usafiri, chakula), bonasi, motisha, na thamani ya manufaa kama vile gari la kampuni au nyumba ya kampuni. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What payments are subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE applies to: basic salary, overtime pay, allowances (housing, transport, meals), bonuses, incentives, and the value of benefits such as company car or company housing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania kwa 2025/2026 ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania Bara (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/mwezi: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% ya ziada; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% ya ziada + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% ya ziada + TZS 68,000; zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000: 30% ya ziada + TZS 128,000. Thibitisha na TRA baada ya kila Finance Act.
question_en: What are the PAYE rates in Tanzania for 2025/2026?
answer_en: Tanzania Mainland PAYE bands (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/month: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% on excess; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% on excess + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% on excess + TZS 68,000; over TZS 1,000,000: 30% on excess + TZS 128,000. Confirm with TRA after each Finance Act.

question_sw: PAYE inarudishwa TRA kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: PAYE inarudishwa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) mtandaoni. Mwajiri anaingiza return ya mwezi na kisha kulipa kupitia GePG au benki iliyoidhinishwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE remitted to TRA?
answer_en: PAYE is remitted through the IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) online system. The employer files a monthly return and pays through GePG or an approved bank. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa PAYE kwa wakati ni ipi?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewsha PAYE ni asilimia 2.5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kufunga akaunti za benki za mwajiri anayekosea. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late PAYE remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late PAYE penalty is 2.5% of the unpaid amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also freeze bank accounts of non-compliant employers. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anatoa taarifa ya kila mwaka ya PAYE TRA lini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anatoa Taarifa ya Mwaka ya PAYE (Annual PAYE Statement) ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata. Taarifa hiyo inaonyesha jumla ya mapato na kodi iliyokatwa kwa kila mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When does an employer submit the annual PAYE reconciliation to TRA?
answer_en: An employer must submit the Annual PAYE Statement (reconciliation) by 31 March of the following year. It shows total income and tax withheld per employee. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, NSSF inakatwa kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mchango wa lazima wa NSSF (asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi) unakatwa mshahara ghafi na unapunguza msingi wa PAYE. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 600,000 analipa NSSF TZS 60,000; PAYE inacheswa kwa TZS 540,000. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF deducted before calculating PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. The mandatory employee NSSF contribution (10% of gross wage) is deducted from gross salary before calculating PAYE. For example, an employee earning TZS 600,000 pays TZS 60,000 NSSF; PAYE is calculated on TZS 540,000. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.

question_sw: Je, SDL inaathiri PAYE ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) inalipwa na mwajiri kutoka mfuko wake mwenyewe — haikimuzi mfanyakazi. SDL haifanyi mabadiliko kwenye msingi wa PAYE wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does SDL affect an employee's PAYE calculation?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) is paid by the employer from their own funds — it is not deducted from the employee. SDL does not change the employee's PAYE base. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Thamani ya nyumba ya kampuni inajumuishwa katika PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Kama mwajiri anatoa nyumba kwa mfanyakazi, thamani ya nyumba hiyo inajumuishwa katika mapato ya mfanyakazi kwa madhumuni ya PAYE. Thamani inahesabiwa kulingana na kanuni za TRA — kwa kawaida ni asilimia ya mshahara wa msingi au kodi ya soko. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is employer-provided housing included in PAYE calculation?
answer_en: If an employer provides housing to an employee, the value of that housing is included in the employee's income for PAYE purposes. The value is calculated according to TRA rules — typically a percentage of basic salary or market rent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Gari la kampuni linalipwa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayetumia gari la kampuni kwa madhumuni ya kibinafsi anapata manufaa yanayostahili PAYE. Thamani ya manufaa inahesabiwa kulingana na sheria ya kodi ya TRA. Mwajiri analazimika kujumuisha thamani hiyo katika mshahara unaostahili PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is a company car taxed under PAYE?
answer_en: An employee who uses a company car for personal purposes receives a taxable benefit subject to PAYE. The benefit value is calculated under TRA tax rules. The employer must include this value in the PAYE-liable payroll. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili au zaidi lazima ataarifu kila mwajiri kuhusu vyanzo vingine vya mapato. Mwajiri mkuu (primary employer) hutumia viwango vya kawaida; waajiri wengine wanatumia kiwango cha juu zaidi (top rate) au makubaliano maalum na TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated for an employee with two employers?
answer_en: An employee with two or more employers must notify each employer of the other income sources. The primary employer uses the normal tax bands; secondary employers apply the highest rate or a special TRA arrangement. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, bonasi na motisha zinapaswa kulipwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Bonasi, motisha (incentives), na malipo ya kipekee yote yanajumuishwa katika mapato yanayostahili PAYE. Yanalipwa mwezi yanayotolewa na PAYE inacheswa kwa msingi wa mwezi huo. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Are bonuses and incentives subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Bonuses, incentives, and one-off payments are all included in PAYE-liable income. They are taxed in the month paid, with PAYE calculated on the total income for that month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Malipo ya mwisho ya kazi (gratuity/terminal benefits) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile malipo ya likizo yasiyotumika, mafao ya kujitenga (gratuity), na malipo ya fidia yanaweza kustahili PAYE kulingana na sheria ya kodi. Sehemu fulani inaweza kuwa huru — thibitisha hesabu halisi na TRA kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: Are terminal benefits and gratuity subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Terminal payments such as unused leave pay-out, gratuity, and severance may be subject to PAYE depending on the tax rules. Certain portions may be exempt — confirm the exact calculation with TRA before payment.

question_sw: Kazi ya ziada (overtime) inalipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya kazi ya ziada yanajumuishwa katika jumla ya mapato ya mwezi na yanastahili PAYE kwa kiwango kinacholingana na kanda ya mapato. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha PAYE kwa overtime peke yake. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is overtime pay subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Overtime pay is included in total monthly earnings and is subject to PAYE at the applicable rate band. There is no separate PAYE rate for overtime. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (casual worker) analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Inategemea: kama mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi anafanya kazi kwa zaidi ya mwezi mmoja mfululizo au kuwa na mapato yanayozidi kiwango cha chini cha PAYE (TZS 270,000/mwezi), mwajiri anapaswa kukata PAYE. Thibitisha hali halisi na TRA.
question_en: Do casual workers pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends: if a casual worker works for more than one month continuously or has earnings exceeding the minimum PAYE threshold (TZS 270,000/month), the employer must deduct PAYE. Confirm the specific situation with TRA.

question_sw: Malipo ya mkurugenzi (director's fee) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya mkurugenzi wa kampuni yanastahili PAYE. Kama mkurugenzi si mfanyakazi wa wakati kamili, yanaweza kustahili kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) badala ya PAYE — kiwango ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 20 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha aina ya mkurugenzi na TRA.
question_en: Are director's fees subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Director's fees are subject to PAYE. If the director is not a full-time employee, the fees may be subject to withholding tax instead of PAYE — the rate is 15% for residents and 20% for non-residents. Confirm the director's classification with TRA.

question_sw: PAYE tofauti na kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE inahusu mapato ya ajira tu — mwajiri anakata na kulipa kila mwezi. Kodi ya zuio inahusu malipo mengine kama vile gawio (dividends), riba, ada za ushauri, na pango — wakala mwingine (mtu anayetoa malipo) anakata na kulipa. Viwango na tarehe za malipo zinatofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE relates only to employment income — the employer deducts and remits monthly. Withholding tax covers other payments such as dividends, interest, consultancy fees, and rent — the paying party deducts and remits. Rates and deadlines differ. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, PAYE inaweza kuomba kurudishwa (refund)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama PAYE iliyokatwa ni zaidi ya kodi halisi, mfanyakazi anaweza kuomba kurudishwa kupitia TRA. Ombi hufanywa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS baada ya kujaza taarifa ya mwaka (individual tax return) ikiwa ni lazima. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can PAYE be refunded if overpaid?
answer_en: Yes. If PAYE deducted exceeds the actual tax liability, the employee can apply for a refund through TRA. The application is made via the IDRAS system after filing the annual return where required. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri inapaswa kulipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Inategemea: posho ya usafiri inayolipwa kupita kiasi cha gharama halisi za kazi (reimbursement ya kweli) inastahili PAYE. Posho inayolipwa kama nyongeza ya mshahara — bila kuhusiana na safari ya kazi — inastahili PAYE kamili. Thibitisha mtiririko halisi na TRA.
question_en: Is a transport allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends: transport allowance paid beyond actual business travel costs (genuine reimbursement) is subject to PAYE. Allowances paid as a salary top-up — not related to business travel — are fully subject to PAYE. Confirm the actual arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuweka rekodi gani za PAYE?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aweke: orodha ya wafanyakazi na TIN zao, hesabu za mishahara, hesabu za PAYE kwa kila mfanyakazi, stakabadhi za malipo ya TRA, na fomu za PAYE P9. Rekodi hizi zinahifadhiwa kwa miaka 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What PAYE records must an employer maintain?
answer_en: An employer must keep: employee list with their TINs, payroll calculations, PAYE calculations per employee, TRA payment receipts, and PAYE P9 forms. Records must be kept for 5 years. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, ruzuku ya matibabu (medical allowance) inastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ruzuku ya matibabu inayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi (cash allowance) inastahili PAYE. Malipo ya matibabu yanayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa hospitali au insurer kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi yanaweza kuwa na nafuu — thibitisha kiasi na TRA.
question_en: Is a medical allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: A medical allowance paid directly to the employee as cash is subject to PAYE. Payments made directly to a hospital or insurer on behalf of the employee may receive a tax relief — confirm the threshold and arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Kama mwajiri hakukata PAYE, nani analipa deni?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anachukuliwa kuwa na jukumu kamili kwa PAYE yote ambayo haikukatwa au hakulipwa TRA, pamoja na faini na riba. TRA inaweza kudai deni hilo moja kwa moja kutoka kwa mwajiri bila kujali kama mfanyakazi alipata mshahara kamili. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: If an employer fails to deduct PAYE, who owes the tax?
answer_en: The employer bears full liability for all PAYE not deducted or remitted to TRA, including penalties and interest. TRA can demand the debt directly from the employer regardless of whether the employee received full pay. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa kwa mwezi mmoja ambao haukuwa na wafanyakazi — toa return?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri aliyesajiliwa PAYE lazima atoe return ya sifuri (nil return) hata kwa miezi ambayo hakuna wafanyakazi au hakuna malipo. Kushindwa kutoa nil return kunasababisha faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Must an employer file a PAYE return for a month with no employees?
answer_en: Yes. A PAYE-registered employer must file a nil return even for months with no employees or no payments. Failure to file a nil return attracts a penalty. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: GN 605A ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 605A ni Amri ya Mishahara ya Sekta ya Faragha (Wage Order) iliyotolewa chini ya ELRA. Inaweka kiwango cha chini cha mishahara (minimum wage) kwa sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 nchini Tanzania Bara. Ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: What is GN 605A in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 605A is the Private Sector Wage Order issued under ELRA. It sets the minimum wage for 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors in Tanzania Mainland. It came into effect on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: GN 605A ilianza tarehe ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Ilisainiwa mnamo Oktoba 2025. Amri ya zamani ya mshahara wa mwaka 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe hiyo hiyo. Thibitisha na TanzLII.
question_en: When did GN 605A come into effect?
answer_en: GN 605A came into effect on 1 January 2026. It was gazetted in October 2025. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from the same date. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 bado inatumika Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026 wakati GN 605A ilipoanza kutumika. Mwajiri anayendelea kulipa kwa viwango vya 2022 anakiuka sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is the 2022 wage order still valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from 1 January 2026 when GN 605A came into force. An employer continuing to pay at 2022 rates is violating the law. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Ongezeko la wastani la mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ongezeko la wastani la sekta ya faragha chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.4 — kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Hii ni wastani kwa sekta zote; sekta fulani zinaongezeka zaidi. Thibitisha kiasi halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the average wage increase under GN 605A?
answer_en: The average private sector increase under GN 605A is 33.4% — from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month. This is the average across all sectors; some sectors increase by more. Confirm your sector's exact amount with MLYWF.

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa kwa sekta ya jumla ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango vinafikia hadi TZS 765,900 kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the lowest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The lowest minimum wage for the general sector is approximately TZS 175,000 per month. Rates reach up to TZS 765,900 for the international mining and energy sector. Confirm your sector's exact rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa ni TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi — inayohusu sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Hii ni kiwango cha chini; waajiri wanaweza kulipa zaidi. Thibitisha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the highest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The highest minimum wage is TZS 765,900 per month — applicable to the international mining and energy sector. This is a floor; employers may pay above this. Confirm your sector with MLYWF.

question_sw: Sekta ya umma inalipwa mshahara gani Tanzania tangu Julai 2025?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali (sekta ya umma) Tanzania Bara wanalipwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi, kuanzia Julai 2025, kufuatia tangazo la Rais Samia. GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ya faragha peke yake. Thibitisha na Hazina au PSC kwa hati rasmi inayothibitisha kiwango na tarehe ya kuanza.
question_en: What is the public sector minimum wage in Tanzania since July 2025?
answer_en: Government employees (public sector) in Tanzania Mainland receive a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month from July 2025, following President Samia's announcement. GN 605A covers the private sector only. Confirm with the Treasury or PSC for the official instrument confirming the rate and effective date.

question_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 za sekta ya faragha Tanzania Bara. Kila sekta ina kiwango chake cha mshahara wa chini kulingana na mazingira ya kazi. Thibitisha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: How many sectors does GN 605A cover?
answer_en: GN 605A covers 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors of the private sector in Tanzania Mainland. Each sector has its own minimum wage level based on working conditions. Confirm your sector with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutekeleza GN 605A ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri alipaswa kutekeleza GN 605A kuanzia malipo ya kwanza ya mishahara ya Januari 2026. Utekelezaji haukuwa na kipindi cha mpito — ufanisi ulianza moja kwa moja tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: When must an employer implement GN 605A?
answer_en: Employers were required to implement GN 605A from the first payroll of January 2026. There was no transition period — the order took effect immediately on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Adhabu kwa mwajiri anayelipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayelipa chini ya kiwango cha mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabili: malimbikizo ya tofauti ya mshahara, faini chini ya ELRA, au kesi ya kisheria iliyowasilishwa na mfanyakazi. Ukaguzi wa MLYWF unaweza kuanzisha hatua za kisheria. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage may face: back-payment of wage shortfalls, fines under ELRA, or legal proceedings filed by the employee. MLYWF labour inspectors can initiate enforcement action. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: mfanyakazi analipa TZS 35,832; mwajiri analipa TZS 35,832 pia. Jumlisha: mchango wote wa NSSF ni TZS 71,664 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated at 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee). On the TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: employee pays TZS 35,832; employer pays TZS 35,832. Total NSSF contribution: TZS 71,664 per month. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: SDL inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills and Development Levy) ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi wote kwa mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: SDL = TZS 12,541 kwa mfanyakazi mmoja kwa mwezi. Inalipwa na mwajiri. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is SDL calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: SDL (Skills and Development Levy) is 3.5% of total gross wages for employers with 10+ employees. On TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: SDL = TZS 12,541 per employee per month. Paid by the employer. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa majaribio (probationary employee) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi katika kipindi cha majaribio ana haki ya angalau kiwango cha chini cha GN 605A cha sekta husika. Muda wa majaribio haupunguzi haki ya mshahara wa chini. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is a probationary employee entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation is entitled to at least the GN 605A minimum wage for their sector. The probation period does not reduce the right to minimum pay. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (part-time) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa msingi wa pro-rata. Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kuhesabiwa kwa idadi ya masaa aliyofanya kazi ikilinganishwa na masaa ya kawaida ya wiki ya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Does a part-time worker have the right to the minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes, on a pro-rata basis. A part-time worker is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage calculated according to the hours worked compared to the normal working week. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: GN 605A inahusu wafanyakazi wa sekta ya kilimo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sekta ya kilimo imejumuishwa katika GN 605A. Kiwango halisi cha mshahara wa chini kwa kilimo kinatofautiana na sekta nyingine — thibitisha kiwango cha sasa kwa sekta ya kilimo na MLYWF.
question_en: Does GN 605A apply to workers in the agricultural sector?
answer_en: Yes. The agricultural sector is included in GN 605A. The exact minimum wage for agriculture differs from other sectors — confirm the current agricultural sector rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mgeni wa Tanzania anaweza kulipwa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote wanaofanya kazi Tanzania Bara, bila kujali uraia. Mwajiri hawezi kulipa mfanyakazi mgeni mshahara chini ya kiwango cha GN 605A. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Can a foreign worker in Tanzania be paid below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: No. GN 605A applies to all workers employed in Tanzania Mainland, regardless of citizenship. An employer cannot pay a foreign employee below the GN 605A rate. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: WCF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi — inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake. Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: WCF = TZS 1,792 kwa mfanyakazi kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na WCF.
question_en: How is WCF calculated on the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is 0.5% of total gross wages — paid by the employer only. On TZS 358,322 minimum wage: WCF = TZS 1,792 per employee per month. Confirm with WCF.

question_sw: Gharama yote ya mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa chini wa wastani wa TZS 358,322/mwezi: NSSF ya mwajiri TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Jumla ya gharama ya ziada kwa mwajiri: TZS 50,165. Gharama yote ya mwajiri: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: What is the total employer cost for one employee at the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: On TZS 358,322/month minimum wage: employer NSSF TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Total employer add-on cost: TZS 50,165. Full employer cost: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/month. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or statutory rate change

question_sw: Nithibitishe kiwango cha mshahara wa chini wa sekta yangu — niende wapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mshahara wa chini kwa sekta yako kinapatikana: (1) Tovuti ya MLYWF (mlywf.go.tz) au ofisi yoyote ya kazi; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — tafuta 'GN 605A'; (3) Shirika la wafanyakazi au chama cha waajiri cha sekta yako. Thibitisha kiwango halisi kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: How do I verify the minimum wage for my specific sector under GN 605A?
answer_en: The minimum wage for your sector is available at: (1) MLYWF website (mlywf.go.tz) or any labour office; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — search 'GN 605A'; (3) Your sector's trade union or employers' association. Confirm the exact rate before processing payroll.

question_sw: Mgeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania anahitaji kibali gani?
answer_sw: Mgeni anayeajiriwa na kampuni Tanzania anahitaji Kibali cha Makazi daraja B (Residence Permit Class B) — kibali cha kufanya kazi. Kibali hutolewa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Mgeni lazima awe na mwajiri rasmi kabla ya kuomba kibali. Kawaida zinahitajika zote mbili: kibali cha kazi kutoka Wizara ya Kazi NA kibali cha makazi daraja B kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What permit does a foreign national employed in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreign national employed by a company in Tanzania needs a Class B Residence Permit — a work permit. It is issued by the Immigration Department. The foreigner must have a formal employer before applying. Usually both are required: a work permit from the Ministry of Labour AND a Class B residence permit from Immigration. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A enforcement update or immigration regulation change

question_sw: Mwekezaji mgeni Tanzania anahitaji kibali gani cha makazi?
answer_sw: Mwekezaji mgeni anayefanya biashara kwa akaunti yake mwenyewe anahitaji Kibali cha Makazi daraja A (Residence Permit Class A) — kinachojulikana kama kibali cha mwekezaji. Kinatolewa kwa wanaofanya uwekezaji unaokidhi vigezo vya TIC. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: What residence permit does a foreign investor in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreign investor running a business on their own account needs a Class A Residence Permit — known as an investor permit. It is granted to those making investments meeting TIC criteria. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
next_review_trigger: Immigration regulation change or GN 487A update

question_sw: Mtu asiye raia anayefanya biashara bila kibali Tanzania anakabili adhabu gani?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025): faini ya chini ya TZS 10,000,000 na/au kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa kwa viza. Sheria hii inashughulikia shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni — ikiwemo biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, na saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What penalty does a non-citizen face for doing business without a permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (effective July 2025): a minimum fine of TZS 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months plus visa revocation. This order covers 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens — including wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, and salons. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A: raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku anakabili faini ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo cha miezi 3 gerezani. Hata kukodisha duka au akaunti ya benki kwa mgeni kwa madhumuni hayo kunaweza kufuatwa. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What risk does a Tanzanian citizen face for helping a non-citizen conduct prohibited business?
answer_en: Under GN 487A: a Tanzanian facilitating a non-citizen's prohibited activities faces a TZS 5,000,000 fine or 3 months imprisonment. Even renting a shop or bank account to a foreigner for such purposes may be pursued. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Ombi la kibali cha makazi Tanzania linafanywa wapi mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Maombi ya vibali vya makazi (daraja A, B, C) yanafanywa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa e-services wa Idara ya Uhamiaji kwenye tovuti immigration.go.tz. Mwombaji anatakiwa kuunda akaunti, kujaza fomu, na kupakia hati zinazohitajika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Where is a Tanzania residence permit application submitted online?
answer_en: Applications for residence permits (Class A, B, C) are submitted online through the Immigration Department's e-services system at immigration.go.tz. The applicant creates an account, completes the form, and uploads required documents. Confirm current requirements with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Vibali 15 vya shughuli vilivyopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A ni vipi?
answer_sw: GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025) inapiga marufuku wageni kufanya: biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni na ususi, na shughuli 11 nyingine zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Biashara ya usambazaji mdogo inajumuishwa. Thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What are the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A (effective July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from conducting: wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon and hairdressing business, and 11 other activities listed in the order. Small distribution business is included. Confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza rasmi tarehe ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 487A ilianza rasmi tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Baadaye, Idara ya Uhamiaji iliendesha operesheni ya utekelezaji kuanzia Septemba 11 hadi Oktoba 8, 2025. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: When did GN 487A officially come into effect?
answer_en: GN 487A officially came into effect on 28 July 2025. Subsequently, the Immigration Services Department conducted an enforcement exercise from 11 September to 8 October 2025. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye kibali cha makazi daraja C anaweza kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku na GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inaweka marufuku ya aina ya shughuli — hata kibali cha kazi halimruhusu mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Sheria hizi mbili zinatumika pamoja. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: Can a non-citizen with a Class C residence permit conduct activities prohibited by GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A restricts the type of activity — even a work permit does not authorise a non-citizen to conduct activities listed in the order. Both laws apply concurrently. Confirm with the Immigration Department and a legal adviser.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kumiliki duka la reja reja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana chini ya GN 487A. Biashara ya reja reja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na wageni haiwezi kufanya biashara ya reja reja Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: Can a foreign-owned company own a retail shop in Tanzania?
answer_en: No under GN 487A. Retail trade is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. A company owned by foreigners cannot conduct retail business in Tanzania Mainland. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Mgeni anafanya ukarabati wa simu Tanzania — ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Ukarabati wa simu ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku na GN 487A. Mgeni anayefanya ukarabati wa simu bila kibali anakabili: faini ya chini ya TZS 10,000,000, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: A non-citizen is running a phone repair shop in Tanzania — what is their risk?
answer_en: Phone repair is one of the 15 activities prohibited by GN 487A. A non-citizen operating phone repair without authorisation faces: a minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Mwombaji wa kibali cha kazi (Class C) Tanzania anahitaji hati gani?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, mwombaji wa Class C anahitaji: passport inayotumika, barua ya mwajiri, mkataba wa kazi, vyeti vya elimu/uzoefu, picha za pasipoti, fomu ya TRA (TIN), na ada ya maombi. Mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What documents does a Class C work permit applicant in Tanzania need?
answer_en: Typically, a Class C applicant needs: a valid passport, employer letter, employment contract, educational/experience certificates, passport photos, TRA form (TIN), and application fee. Requirements may vary — confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi Tanzania kinadumu kwa muda gani?
answer_sw: Kibali cha makazi daraja C kawaida kinatolewa kwa kipindi cha hadi miaka 2, kinachoweza kuhuishwa. Kibali cha daraja B (mwekezaji) kinaweza kutolewa kwa hadi miaka 5. Thibitisha muda halisi wa aina yako ya kibali na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: How long is a work permit valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: A Class C residence permit is typically issued for up to 2 years, renewable. A Class B (investor) permit may be issued for up to 5 years. Confirm the exact duration for your permit type with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Mgeni anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi Tanzania kabla ya kupata kibali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mgeni lazima apate kibali cha makazi (Class C) kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi. Kufanya kazi kabla ya kibali ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya uhamiaji na unaweza kusababisha kufukuzwa nchini. Mwajiri pia anachukuliwa na jukumu. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a non-citizen start working in Tanzania before receiving their permit?
answer_en: No. A non-citizen must obtain a Class C residence permit before starting work. Working before a permit is an immigration law violation and can result in deportation. The employer also bears liability. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi Class C Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi daraja C inaweza kutofautiana kulingana na muda na aina ya kazi. Ada zinatofautiana sana kulingana na aina ya kibali, uraia, na muda — angalia jedwali la sasa la ada kwenye immigration.go.tz
question_en: What is the fee for a Class C residence permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Class C residence permit fee varies depending on duration and type of employment. Fees vary widely by permit class, nationality and duration — check current schedule at immigration.go.tz

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji TIN kabla ya kumwomba mfanyakazi mgeni kibali cha kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyotolewa na TRA na iwe imesajiliwa kisheria Tanzania kabla ya kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi mgeni. Idara ya Uhamiaji inataka uthibitisho wa usajili wa kampuni na hali ya kodi. Thibitisha na TRA na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Does an employer need a TIN before sponsoring a foreign work permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. The company must have a TRA-issued TIN and be legally registered in Tanzania before applying for a work permit for a foreign employee. The Immigration Department requires proof of company registration and tax compliance. Confirm with TRA and the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio lazima ilipwe TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi wa kalenda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya zuio iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: Withholding tax must be remitted to TRA within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. For example, withholding tax deducted in January is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa bidhaa na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 3, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on goods in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of goods by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 3%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa huduma ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa huduma na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 6, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on services in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of services by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 6%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio (dividends) kwa kampuni zilizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zilizoorodheshwa kwenye Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) ni asilimia 5 — kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) listed companies is 5% — for both residents and non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zingine (zisizoorodheshwa DSE) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zisizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kama kampuni inayopokea gawio inamiliki zaidi ya asilimia 25 ya hisa — kiwango ni asilimia 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. If the recipient company holds 25%+ of shares — the rate is 5%. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba (interest) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on interest in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya mrabaha (royalties) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya mrabaha ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on royalties in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on royalties is 15% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) ni asilimia 5 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on service fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on service fees is 5% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara (commercial rent) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on commercial rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on commercial rent is 10% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili (non full-time director) inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax rate applies to non-full-time director fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: Non-full-time director fees are subject to 15% withholding tax for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho (final withholding tax) na isiyo ya mwisho (non-final) ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho: mpokeaji haawezi kudai mkopo wa kodi — kodi hiyo ndiyo ya mwisho kabisa kwa mapato hayo. Kodi ya zuio isiyo ya mwisho: mpokeaji anaweza kudai mkopo dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwaka. Thibitisha hali ya malipo yako na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between final and non-final withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: Final withholding tax: the recipient cannot claim a tax credit — it is the final tax on that income. Non-final withholding tax: the recipient can claim a credit against their annual tax liability. Confirm your payment classification with TRA.

question_sw: Wakala wa zuio (withholding agent) ni nani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ni mtu anayehitajika kisheria kukata kodi ya zuio kutoka kwa malipo anayofanya. Wakala wa zuio ni: serikali na taasisi zake, makampuni, na watu binafsi waliotajwa na sheria. Wakala anapaswa kusajiliwa TRA na kulipa ndani ya siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Who is a withholding agent in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent is a person legally required to deduct withholding tax from payments they make. Withholding agents include: government and its institutions, companies, and specified individuals. The agent must be registered with TRA and pay within 7 days. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya malipo ya bidhaa kwa serikali Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya bidhaa zinazotolewa kwa serikali na taasisi zake yanastahili kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 2 ya malipo ghafi. Hii inashughulikia wazabuni wote wanaouza bidhaa kwa serikali. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax applies to payments for goods supplied to the government in Tanzania?
answer_en: Payments for goods supplied to the government and its institutions are subject to 2% withholding tax on gross payment. This applies to all suppliers selling goods to government entities. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa kodi ya zuio kwa wakati Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ambaye hakulipa kwa wakati anakabili: faini ya asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu yake, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kudai malipo moja kwa moja kutoka kwa wakala. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late withholding tax remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent who pays late faces: a 5% penalty on the overdue amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also claim the payment directly from the agent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kupata cheti cha kodi ya zuio (withholding tax certificate) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio kinapatikana kupitia mfumo wa malipo ya kodi (Tax Payment) kwenye Lango la Walipa Kodi (Taxpayer Portal) wa TRA. Kinachapishwa na wakala wa zuio au mtu aliyekatwa kodi (withholdee) baada ya malipo kukamilika. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How do you obtain a withholding tax certificate in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding tax certificate is obtained through the Tax Payment section of TRA's Taxpayer Portal. It can be printed by either the withholding agent or the withholdee after payment is completed. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) yanastahili VAT ya asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) ya bidhaa na huduma yanastahili VAT ya asilimia sifuri (zero-rated) ikiwa na uthibitisho wa kufilisi bidhaa nje ya Tanzania Bara. VAT ya sifuri inaruhusu msajiliwa kudai mkopo wa pembejeo (input tax credit). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to exports of goods and services from Tanzania?
answer_en: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated (0% VAT) provided there is proof of consumption/supply outside Tanzania Mainland. Zero-rating allows the registered person to claim input tax credit. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara inayoanza — inaweza kusajili VAT kabla ya kufikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu anayekusudia kufanya biashara (intending trader) anaweza kuomba usajili wa hiari wa VAT wakati wowote, mradi atoe uthibitisho wa kutosha kama vile mikataba, zabuni, mipango ya ujenzi, au ufadhili wa benki. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a start-up register for VAT before reaching the TZS 200M threshold?
answer_en: Yes. An intending trader can apply for voluntary VAT registration at any time, provided they submit sufficient evidence such as contracts, tenders, building plans, or bank financing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, VAT inastahili kwa bidhaa na huduma zote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT inastahili kwa usambazaji unaostahili (taxable supply) peke yake unaofanywa na mtu msajiliwa katika mwendo wa shughuli za kiuchumi. Usambazaji fulani una kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) au umeachiliwa (exempt). Thibitisha hali ya bidhaa/huduma yako na TRA.
question_en: Does VAT apply to all goods and services in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. VAT applies only to taxable supplies made by a registered person in the course of economic activities. Some supplies are zero-rated or exempt. Confirm the status of your goods/services with TRA.

question_sw: VAT ya uingizaji (imports) inafanyaje kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT ya asilimia 18 inastahili kwa uingizaji wa bidhaa zinazostahili kutoka nje ya Tanzania Bara. Uingizaji wa huduma pia unastahili VAT. Sheria za kawaida za Forodha zinatumika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya VAT ya uingizaji na TRA na Forodha.
question_en: How does VAT on imports work in Tanzania?
answer_en: 18% VAT applies to the importation of taxable goods from outside Tanzania Mainland. Importation of services is also subject to VAT. Normal Customs laws and procedures apply. Confirm import VAT requirements with TRA and Customs.

question_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT ambaye hajafikia kizingiti anapaswa kujisajili wenyewe — je, TRA anaweza kumsajili bila ombi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa Kamishna Mkuu ameridhika kwamba mtu anahitajika kusajiliwa VAT na ana sababu nzuri — ikiwemo kulinda mapato ya serikali — anaweza kumsajili bila ombi na kumwarifu ndani ya siku 14 baada ya usajili. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can TRA register a business for VAT without an application?
answer_en: Yes. If the Commissioner General is satisfied that a person must register for VAT and there is good reason — including protection of government revenue — they can register that person without an application and notify them within 14 days of registration. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Nambari ya usajili wa VAT inatumika kwa madhumuni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Nambari ya usajili wa VAT (VAT registration number) inatumika: kwenye hati za VAT (invoices, returns), pamoja na TIN kwenye nyaraka za rasmi za VAT, na lazima ionekane kwenye Cheti cha Usajili cha VAT mahali panapoonekana kazini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT registration number used for in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT registration number is used: on VAT documents (invoices, returns), alongside the TIN on official VAT documents, and must be displayed on the VAT Registration Certificate in a visible place at the principal business premises. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mtu lazima asajili VAT ndani ya muda gani baada ya kufikia kizingiti?
answer_sw: Mtu anayehitajika kusajiliwa VAT lazima afanye maombi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kukosa kusajili kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha usajili wa lazima na faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Within what time must a business register for VAT after reaching the threshold?
answer_en: A person required to register for VAT must apply to the Commissioner General within 30 days of reaching the threshold. Failing to register on time may result in compulsory registration and penalties. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Watoa huduma wa kitaalamu (professional service providers) wanastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, watoa huduma wa kitaalamu wanastahili usajili wa VAT kama wanafikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6. Wanaweza pia kusajili kwa hiari kabla ya kufikia kizingiti. Thibitisha hali ya huduma zako maalum na TRA.
question_en: Do professional service providers qualify for VAT registration in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, professional service providers qualify for VAT registration if they reach the TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6-month threshold. They can also voluntarily register before reaching the threshold. Confirm the status of your specific services with TRA.

question_sw: Usambazaji wa bidhaa nje ya Tanzania Bara unastahili VAT ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Bidhaa zinazosambazwa au huduma zinazofurahiwa nje ya Tanzania Bara zinastahili kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) kwa kutoa uthibitisho. Hii inatofautiana na msamaha (exempt) — msajiliwa wa VAT anaweza kudai input tax credit kwa usambazaji wa zero-rated. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is a supply consumed outside Tanzania Mainland subject to Tanzania VAT?
answer_en: Supplies consumed or enjoyed outside Tanzania Mainland are zero-rated upon proof. This differs from exempt — a VAT-registered person can claim input tax credit on zero-rated supplies. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: VAT inalipwa kwa muda gani na msajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT analipa VAT kupitia return ya VAT ya kila mwezi. Return na malipo yanatolewa ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa biashara. Thibitisha tarehe na TRA.
question_en: When does a VAT registrant file and pay VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT registrant pays VAT through a monthly VAT return. The return and payment are due by the 20th of the month following the trading month. Confirm the deadline with TRA.

question_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka lini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka siku VAT inapokuwa stahili kulipwa (the day VAT becomes payable) — si tarehe 20 ya mwezi. Tarehe 20 ni ya kufungua return ya VAT, ambayo ni wajibu tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must a VAT withholding certificate be issued?
answer_en: A VAT withholding certificate must be issued on the day VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th of the month. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline, which is a separate obligation. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inayoanza (intending trader) inaweza kusajili VAT bila kuwa na mapato bado?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu anayekusudia kufanya biashara (intending trader) anaweza kuomba usajili wa VAT 'wakati wowote' mradi atoe ushahidi wa kutosha kama vile mikataba, zabuni, mipango ya ujenzi, mipango ya biashara, au ufadhili wa benki. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a new start-up (intending trader) register for VAT with no revenue yet?
answer_en: Yes. An intending trader can apply for VAT registration 'at any time' provided they present sufficient evidence such as contracts, tenders, building plans, business plans, or bank financing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, serikali na taasisi zake zinastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Serikali na taasisi zake zinaweza kuwa wasajiliwa wa VAT kama zinafanya shughuli za kiuchumi. Pia zinaweza kuwa wakala wa zuio ya VAT. Thibitisha hali halisi ya shughuli za taasisi husika na TRA.
question_en: Are government entities and institutions subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Government entities and institutions may be VAT registrants if they carry on economic activities. They may also serve as VAT withholding agents. Confirm the specific situation for the institution concerned with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara ya B2C ya malipo ya kidijitali ina VAT ya asilimia ngapi kuanzia Septemba 2025?
answer_sw: Shughuli za B2C za malipo ya kidijitali (e-payment) zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 16 kuanzia tarehe 1 Septemba 2025. Kanuni za utekelezaji zingali zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Thibitisha hali ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to B2C digital payment transactions from September 2025?
answer_en: B2C e-payment transactions are subject to 16% VAT from 1 September 2025. Implementation rules are pending a notice from the TRA Commissioner General. Confirm the current status with TRA.

question_sw: Usajili wa VAT unafanywa kupitia mfumo gani wa TRA?
answer_sw: Maombi ya usajili wa VAT yanafanywa kupitia Lango la Walipa Kodi (IDRAS — Taxpayer Portal) kwenye tovuti ya TRA baada ya mteja kuingia kwenye akaunti yake. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: Which TRA system is used to apply for VAT registration?
answer_en: VAT registration applications are made through TRA's Taxpayer Portal (IDRAS) on the TRA website after the applicant logs into their account. Confirm current requirements with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa mchango wote wa NSSF 20% bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kulipa mchango wote wa asilimia 20 bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi (asilimia 10) kutoka mshahara wake. Hii ni chaguo la mwajiri — si lazima lakini inaruhusiwa na Sheria ya NSSF. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer pay the full 20% NSSF contribution without deducting the employee's share?
answer_en: Yes. An employer may choose to remit the full 20% contribution without deducting the employee's share (10%) from their wage. This is the employer's option — not mandatory but permitted under the NSSF Act. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mpango mbadala wa NSSF (15%/5%) unafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Badala ya mgawanyo wa kawaida wa 10%/10%, mwajiri anaweza kulipa asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5. Jumla bado ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Mpango huu unaruhusiwa chini ya Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How does the alternative NSSF arrangement (15%/5%) work?
answer_en: Instead of the standard 10%/10% split, the employer may pay 15% and the employee 5%. The total remains 20% of gross wage. This arrangement is permitted under the NSSF Act Section 12. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF ni asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi baada ya tarehe ya malipo. Faini inakusanywa kama deni kutoka kwa mwajiri. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: What is the penalty for late NSSF contribution payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late NSSF contribution penalty is 5% of the unpaid amount for each month or part of a month after the due date. The penalty is recovered as a debt from the employer. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway). Mwajiri analazimika pia kutoa nyaraka za usaidizi (fomu NSSF/CON.05) kwenye ofisi ya NSSF mara tu baada ya malipo — kwa utoaji wa kimwili au njia ya kielektroniki. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF paid in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system. The employer must also submit supporting documents (NSSF/CON.05 form) to the NSSF office immediately after payment — by physical delivery or electronic means. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mwajiri mwenye matawi mengi atalipa NSSF ofisi ipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya waajiri wenye ofisi zaidi ya mkoa mmoja inalipwa kwenye Ofisi ya NSSF ambayo mchango ulipelekwa. Ofisi za kikanda zinahitajika kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa mwajiri mwenye matawi tofauti. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Which NSSF office does a multi-branch employer pay contributions to?
answer_en: Contributions for employers with offices in more than one region are accounted for at the NSSF office where the contribution was remitted. Regional offices must cooperate to ensure compliance of employers with different branches. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) au mshahara wa msingi (basic salary)?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Mshahara ghafi unajumuisha mishahara yote ya lazima kabla ya makato yoyote. Thibitisha ufafanuzi kamili wa 'mshahara wa jumla' na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF calculated on gross wage or basic salary in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on gross wage — not basic salary alone. Gross wage includes all compulsory remuneration before any deductions. Confirm the full definition of 'total wage' with NSSF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa NSSF mara mbili?
answer_sw: Inategemea: kila mwajiri anapaswa kulipa NSSF kwa mfanyakazi wake. Kama mfanyakazi ana waajiri wawili, NSSF inalipwa na kila mwajiri kwa kipande cha mshahara kinachohusika. Thibitisha mpangilio sahihi na NSSF.
question_en: Does an employee working for two employers pay NSSF twice?
answer_en: It depends: each employer must pay NSSF for their employee. If an employee has two employers, each pays NSSF on their respective portion of wages. Confirm the correct arrangement with NSSF.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuacha kulipa NSSF kwa sababu biashara inazorota?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF ni mchango wa lazima chini ya sheria — mwajiri hawezi kuacha kulipa hata kama biashara inazorota au inakabili matatizo ya fedha. Kushindwa kulipa kunasababisha faini ya asilimia 5 kwa mwezi na madai ya kisheria. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer stop paying NSSF because the business is struggling financially?
answer_en: No. NSSF is a mandatory statutory contribution — an employer cannot stop paying even if the business is struggling financially. Failure to pay attracts a 5% monthly penalty and legal claims. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12, mchango wa NSSF unapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja (within one month) baada ya mwisho wa mwezi husika. Thibitisha tarehe halisi na NSSF kwani sheria inaweza kusomwa tofauti na mazoea ya vitendo.
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be paid after the end of the month?
answer_en: Under the NSSF Act Section 12, contributions must be paid within one month after the end of the relevant month. Confirm the exact deadline with NSSF as the law may be interpreted differently from practical arrangements.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya — lini anapaswa kusajili NSSF?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mpya anapaswa kusajili NSSF mara tu anapoanza kuajiri wafanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Lango la Huduma la NSSF (NSSF Self Service Portal) au ofisi yoyote ya NSSF. Thibitisha tarehe na mahitaji ya usajili na NSSF.
question_en: When must a new employer register with NSSF?
answer_en: A new employer must register with NSSF as soon as they start employing workers. Registration is done through the NSSF Self Service Portal or any NSSF office. Confirm the registration timeline and requirements with NSSF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anamaliza kazi baada ya miaka 10. Kampuni inalipa TZS 5,000,000 kama mafao ya mwisho. Je, PAYE inatolewa kwenye malipo hayo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile mafao, gratuity na bonasi ya kustaafu yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa kodi. Mwajiri lazima ahesabu PAYE kwenye malipo hayo na kuiwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha kodi kinatumika kulingana na jedwali la kawaida la PAYE — mapato ya mwezi huo yote pamoja. Unaweza kujua zaidi kwenye tra.go.tz.
answer_en: Yes. Under the Income Tax Act, employment termination benefits including gratuity, severance pay, and retirement bonuses are included in taxable employment income. The employer must calculate PAYE on these payments and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The normal PAYE tax bands apply — total income for that month is taxed. See tra.go.tz for details.
question_en: An employee completes 10 years of service. The company pays TZS 5,000,000 as terminal benefits. Is PAYE deducted from this payment?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332

question_sw: Kampuni inampa mfanyakazi gari la kampuni kutumia nyumbani na kazini. Je, thamani ya gari hilo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Matumizi ya kibinafsi ya gari la kampuni yanachukuliwa kama faida ya ajira (benefit in kind) na yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa PAYE. TRA inakadiri thamani ya matumizi ya kibinafsi kulingana na kanuni. Mwajiri lazima aongeze thamani hiyo kwenye mshahara wa mwezi wakati anahesabu PAYE. Hoja kwamba gari ni la kazi peke yake haipokewi bila ushahidi wa kutosha.
answer_en: Yes. Personal use of a company car is treated as a benefit in kind and is included in taxable employment income subject to PAYE. TRA estimates the value of private use according to prescribed rules. The employer must add this deemed value to the employee's monthly salary when calculating PAYE. A claim that the car is used purely for business purposes requires sufficient evidence.
question_en: A company provides an employee with a company car for both home and work use. Is the value of the car use subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 s.7

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anafanya kazi Tanzania na Kenya kwa asilimia 60 na 40 kwa mtiririko. Nani analipa PAYE nchini Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa Tanzania, PAYE inalipwa kwa sehemu ya mshahara inayohusiana na kazi iliyofanywa Tanzania (asilimia 60). Mwajiri anayemlipa mfanyakazi lazima ahifadhi rekodi wazi za siku za kufanya kazi kila nchi. Kama mwajiri ana makao makuu Tanzania, kawaida analipa PAYE kwenye mshahara wote kwanza, kisha anaweza kudai msamaha wa kodi (tax credit) kwa sehemu iliyotozwa Kenya ikiwa kuna makubaliano ya kuzuia utozwaji kodi mara mbili (DTA). Thibitisha mpango wako na mshauri wa kodi wa TRA.
answer_en: For Tanzania, PAYE applies to the portion of salary relating to work performed in Tanzania (60%). An employer paying the employee must maintain clear records of working days in each country. If the employer is resident in Tanzania, they typically withhold PAYE on total salary first, then a tax credit may be claimed for the portion taxed in Kenya under a double taxation agreement (DTA). Confirm your arrangement with a TRA-registered tax consultant.
question_en: An employee works 60% in Tanzania and 40% in Kenya. Who pays PAYE in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 + DTA provisions

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kuwasilisha fomu gani TRA mwishoni mwa mwaka wa mapato kwa kila mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aandae na kuwasilisha Fomu P9 kwa kila mfanyakazi ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata mwaka wa mapato. Fomu P9 inaonyesha jumla ya mshahara wa mwaka, PAYE iliyokatwa, na mchango wa NSSF. Nakala moja inatolewa kwa mfanyakazi na moja inawasilishwa TRA. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha fomu P9 kunasababisha adhabu.
answer_en: An employer must prepare and submit Form P9 for each employee by 31 March of the year following the tax year. Form P9 shows the total annual salary, PAYE deducted, and NSSF contributions. One copy is given to the employee and one is filed with TRA. Late submission of Form P9 attracts penalties.
question_en: What form must an employer submit to TRA at the end of the tax year for each employee?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — P9 Annual Employer Return

question_sw: Shamba la kahawa linaajiri wafanyakazi wa msimu wa mavuno kwa miezi 3 tu. Je, lazima litoe PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ikiwa mshahara wa msimu unazidi kiwango kisichoweza kutozwa kodi. Kiwango cha msingi kisicotozwa kodi ni TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi. Kama mfanyakazi wa msimu anapata zaidi ya TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi, mwajiri lazima akatae PAYE ya mwezi huo na kuiwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Wafanyakazi wa msimu hawana msamaha maalum wa PAYE.
answer_en: Yes, if the seasonal salary exceeds the tax-free threshold. The tax-free threshold is TZS 270,000 per month. If a seasonal worker earns more than TZS 270,000 per month, the employer must deduct PAYE for that month and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month. Seasonal workers have no special PAYE exemption.
question_en: A coffee farm employs seasonal workers for harvest for only 3 months. Must it deduct PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to tax bands

question_sw: Kampuni inalipa michango ya pension kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi kwenye mfuko ulioibuliwa na Serikali. Je, michango hiyo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Michango ya mwajiri kwenye mfuko wa pension ulioibuliwa (kama NSSF, PPF, GEPF) haijumuishwi kwenye mapato ya mfanyakazi yanayotozwa PAYE, mpaka kiasi kinachokubalika kisheria. Lakini michango ya ziada zaidi ya kikomo cha kisheria inaweza kutozwa. Michango ya mfanyakazi mwenyewe kwenye mifuko iliyoidhinishwa inaweza kudaiwa kama punguzo la kodi (allowable deduction) wakati wa mahesabu ya PAYE. Thibitisha kikomo halisi cha mwaka huu na TRA.
answer_en: Employer contributions to an approved pension fund (such as NSSF, PPF, GEPF) are not included in the employee's taxable employment income, up to the legally permitted limit. Contributions above the statutory ceiling may be taxable. Employee contributions to approved funds may be claimed as an allowable deduction when calculating PAYE. Verify the current year ceiling with TRA.
question_en: A company pays pension contributions on behalf of an employee to a government-approved fund. Are those contributions subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 pension provisions

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ilikata PAYE kidogo sana kwa mfanyakazi kwa makosa ya hesabu. Ninafanyaje marekebisho?
answer_sw: Unahitaji kuwasilisha TRA return ya marekebisho (amended return) kwa mwezi husika. Lipa tofauti ya PAYE iliyokosekana pamoja na riba ya kisheria inayowekwa na TRA (thibitisha kiwango cha sasa). Taarisha TRA kupitia barua yenye maelezo ya kosa. Ikiwa kosa linagundulika kabla ya muda wa ukaguzi, kujisalimisha kwa hiari (voluntary disclosure) kunaweza kupunguza adhabu. Wasiliana na TRA service desk au ofisi ya karibu nawe.
answer_en: You need to file an amended PAYE return with TRA for the affected month. Pay the shortfall plus statutory interest at the rate set by TRA (confirm current rate). Notify TRA in writing with an explanation of the error. If the error is discovered before an audit, voluntary disclosure may reduce penalties. Contact the TRA service desk or nearest TRA office.
question_en: Our company deducted too little PAYE from an employee due to a calculation error. How do we correct this?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — amended return and voluntary disclosure

question_sw: Wakati TRA inakagua PAYE ya kampuni yangu, wanakagua nini hasa?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa PAYE, TRA wanakagua: orodha ya mishahara (payroll) kwa miaka yote inayopitiwa, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mshahara, mikataba ya ajira ya wafanyakazi, return za PAYE zilizowasilishwa, fomu za P9 zilizotolewa kwa wafanyakazi, vielelezo vya michango ya ziada kama posho za nyumba na usafiri, na malipo yoyote yanayosemekana kuwa ya 'mkopo' au 'kama ada'. Tofauti kati ya rekodi za benki na payroll ni dalili kuu ya udanganyifu.
answer_en: During a PAYE audit, TRA examines: payroll records for all years under review, bank statements showing salary payments, employment contracts, submitted PAYE returns, P9 forms issued to employees, documentation for additional payments such as housing and transport allowances, and any payments classified as 'loans' or 'fees'. Discrepancies between bank records and the payroll are a key fraud indicator.
question_en: When TRA audits our company's PAYE, what exactly do they examine?

question_sw: Wakala wa mauzo analipwa commission tu — hakuna mshahara wa msingi. Je, PAYE inahusu vipi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, PAYE inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wanaolipwa commission peke yake. Kila mwezi, mwajiri anahesabu PAYE kwenye jumla ya commission iliyolipwa mwezi huo kwa kutumia jedwali la kawaida la PAYE. Mwezi bila commission = hakuna PAYE ya kulipa. Mwezi wa commission kubwa = PAYE kubwa zaidi. Mwajiri lazima aandike rekodi za miamala yote ya commission na PAYE inayohusiana.
answer_en: Yes, PAYE applies to employees paid commission only. Each month, the employer calculates PAYE on the total commission paid that month using the normal PAYE tax bands. A month with no commission = no PAYE due. A month with large commission = higher PAYE. The employer must record all commission transactions and the corresponding PAYE.
question_en: A sales agent is paid commission only — no base salary. How does PAYE apply?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332

question_sw: Kampuni inalipia mfanyakazi tikiti ya ndege ya kwenda mkutano wa biashara. Je, tikiti hiyo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hapana, ikiwa safari ni ya biashara ya kweli na kampuni inalipa moja kwa moja au kumpa risiti ya malipo. Malipo ya gharama halisi za biashara zilizothibitishwa hayajumuishwi kwenye mapato yanayotozwa PAYE. Lakini ikiwa mfanyakazi anapewa posho ya jumla (lump sum) bila kuhitajika kutoa risiti, posho hiyo inatozwa PAYE. Akaunti za gharama lazima ziwe na kumbukumbu sahihi za safari.
answer_en: No, if the travel is genuine business travel and the company pays directly or reimburses against receipts. Reimbursement of actual documented business expenses is not included in taxable employment income. However, if the employee is given a flat allowance without requiring receipts, that allowance is subject to PAYE. Expense accounts must maintain proper travel records.
question_en: A company pays an employee's flight ticket to attend a business conference. Is that ticket subject to PAYE?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana mapato mawili — mshahara wa kampuni ya A na kazi ya sehemu kwa kampuni ya B. Je, kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kwenye mshahara wake peke yake kwa kutumia jedwali la kawaida. Tatizo ni kwamba mfanyakazi anapata msamaha wa TZS 270,000/mwezi mara mbili — moja kwa kila mwajiri — wakati anapaswa kupata mara moja tu. Mwishoni mwa mwaka, mfanyakazi anaweza kulazimika kulipa PAYE ya ziada ikiwa jumla ya mapato kutoka pande zote mbili inasababisha kodi ya juu zaidi. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kuripoti hali hii kwa TRA kupitia kujaza return ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: Each employer withholds PAYE on their own salary payment using the normal tax bands. The problem is that the employee receives the TZS 270,000/month personal relief twice — once from each employer — when they are entitled to it only once. At year end, the employee may owe additional PAYE if combined income from both sources falls into a higher tax band. The employee should report this situation to TRA by filing an individual income tax return.
question_en: An employee has two incomes — a salary from Company A and part-time work at Company B. How much PAYE does each employer deduct?

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika ikiwa mwajiri halipi PAYE kwa wakati ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi?
answer_sw: Ikiwa PAYE haijalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, adhabu ya 2.5% ya kiwango kisicholipwa inatumika kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji au sehemu ya mwezi. Zaidi ya hayo, riba ya kisheria inayowekwa na TRA (thibitisha kiwango cha sasa na TRA) inaongezwa kwenye kiasi kisicholipwa. Adhabu hizi zinaendelea kukusanyika hadi PAYE yote ilipwe. TRA pia ina mamlaka ya kuchukua hatua za kisheria dhidi ya mwajiri asiyetii.
answer_en: If PAYE is not paid by the 7th of the following month, a 2.5% penalty on the unpaid amount applies for each month or part of a month of delay. Additionally, statutory interest at the rate set by TRA (confirm current rate with TRA) is charged on the unpaid balance. These penalties continue to accumulate until the full PAYE is paid. TRA also has authority to take legal enforcement action against a non-compliant employer.
question_en: What penalty applies if an employer does not pay PAYE on time by the 7th of the month?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to penalty rates

question_sw: Kampuni inampa mfanyakazi posho ya nyumba ya TZS 300,000 kila mwezi. Je, posho hiyo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Posho ya nyumba (housing allowance) inajumuishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira yanayotozwa PAYE bila kujali kama inaitwa 'posho' au 'mshahara'. TZS 300,000 ya posho ya nyumba inaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa msingi kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE ya mwezi. Tofauti pekee ni ikiwa kampuni inadhihirisha nyumba yake wenyewe (company accommodation) — hapo thamani ya manufaa inakadiriwa tofauti.
answer_en: Yes. Housing allowance is included in taxable employment income subject to PAYE regardless of whether it is called an 'allowance' or 'salary'. The TZS 300,000 housing allowance is added to the basic salary before calculating monthly PAYE. The only difference is where the company provides its own accommodation (company accommodation) — in that case the value of the benefit is assessed differently.
question_en: A company pays an employee a housing allowance of TZS 300,000 per month. Is that allowance subject to PAYE?

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri ya TZS 50,000 kwa mwezi inayolipwa kwa mfanyakazi — inatozwa PAYE au la?
answer_sw: Inategemea jinsi inavyolipwa. Ikiwa ni posho ya jumla (flat allowance) bila kuhitajika risiti — inatozwa PAYE. Ikiwa ni malipo ya gharama halisi za usafiri wa biashara yanayolipwa dhidi ya risiti — hayatozwi PAYE. Posho nyingi za usafiri zinazolipwa kwa wafanyakazi wa Tanzania zinachukuliwa kama sehemu ya mapato ya ajira na zinatozwa PAYE. Hakikisha una sera ya gharama wazi inayoelezea msingi wa malipo.
answer_en: It depends on how it is paid. If it is a flat allowance without requiring receipts — it is subject to PAYE. If it is reimbursement of actual business travel costs against receipts — it is not subject to PAYE. Most transport allowances paid to employees in Tanzania are treated as part of employment income and are subject to PAYE. Ensure you have a clear expenses policy explaining the basis of payment.
question_en: A transport allowance of TZS 50,000 per month paid to an employee — is it subject to PAYE or not?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or TRA circular on allowances

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mpya anaanza kazi Aprili badala ya Januari. Mwajiri anahesabu PAYE yake vipi kwa mwaka huo?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anahesabu PAYE kuanzia mwezi wa kwanza wa ajira (Aprili). Hakuna marekebisho ya nyuma kwa miezi ya kabla ya ajira. Kwa mwaka huo, mfanyakazi anaweza kupata msamaha wa kibinafsi (personal relief) kwa miezi 9 tu (Aprili–Desemba) kupitia mwajiri. Ikiwa mfanyakazi alifanya kazi pengine kabla ya Aprili na anapaswa kulipa kodi ya ziada, atajaza return ya mtu binafsi mwishoni mwa mwaka.
answer_en: The employer calculates PAYE from the first month of employment (April). There is no retrospective adjustment for months before employment. For that year, the employee receives personal relief for only 9 months (April–December) through the employer. If the employee worked elsewhere before April and owes additional tax, they will file an individual income tax return at year end.
question_en: A new employee starts work in April instead of January. How does the employer calculate PAYE for that year?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata mshahara wa TZS 250,000 kwa mwezi tu. Je, mwajiri anahitajika kukata PAYE?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha msingi kisichotozwa kodi ni TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi. Mshahara wa TZS 250,000 uko chini ya kikomo hiki, kwa hiyo hakuna PAYE ya kukatwa. Hata hivyo, mwajiri bado lazima awe na rekodi ya mfanyakazi na aweze kuthibitisha mshahara huu kwa ukaguzi wa TRA. Ikiwa mshahara utaongezwa juu ya TZS 270,000, PAYE itaanza kutumika mara moja.
answer_en: No. The tax-free monthly threshold is TZS 270,000. A salary of TZS 250,000 is below this threshold, so no PAYE is deducted. However, the employer must still maintain a record of the employee and be able to demonstrate this salary to TRA during an audit. If the salary rises above TZS 270,000, PAYE will apply immediately.
question_en: An employee earns only TZS 250,000 per month. Must the employer deduct PAYE?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to tax bands

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata overtime ya TZS 200,000 na bonus ya TZS 300,000 mwezi huu. Je, vinatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Overtime na bonus zote zinaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa kawaida wa mwezi huo kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE. Kwa mfano, mshahara wa msingi wa TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = mapato ya mwezi TZS 1,000,000. PAYE inakokotolewa kwenye TZS 1,000,000 kulingana na jedwali la PAYE. Hakuna msamaha maalum wa overtime au bonus Tanzania.
answer_en: Yes. Overtime and bonuses are both added to the regular monthly salary before calculating PAYE. For example: basic salary TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = monthly income TZS 1,000,000. PAYE is calculated on TZS 1,000,000 according to the PAYE tax bands. There is no special exemption for overtime or bonuses in Tanzania.
question_en: An employee receives overtime of TZS 200,000 and a bonus of TZS 300,000 this month. Are they subject to PAYE?

question_sw: Mwajiri anatoa cheti gani kwa mfanyakazi wakati anamaliza kazi ili kuthibitisha PAYE iliyokatwa?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anatoa Hati ya Kuacha Kazi au sehemu husika ya Fomu P9 inayoonyesha jumla ya mapato na PAYE iliyokatwa hadi tarehe ya kumaliza kazi. Thibitisha hati halisi inayohitajika na TRA.
