Pia, ifikapo Januari 31 ya mwaka unaofuata, mwajiri anatoa Fomu P9 ikionyesha mapato ya mwaka mzima na PAYE yote iliyokatwa. Mfanyakazi anahifadhi fomu hizi kwa matumizi ya return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: The employer issues a Leaving Certificate or relevant part of Form P9 showing total earnings and PAYE deducted up to the date of leaving. Confirm the exact document required with TRA. Also, by 31 January of the following year, the employer issues Form P9 showing full-year earnings and total PAYE deducted. The employee retains these forms for their individual tax return.
question_en: What certificate does an employer give an employee when they leave employment to confirm the PAYE deducted?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — P45 and P9 forms

question_sw: Kampuni inalipia mfanyakazi chakula cha mchana (lunch) kila siku kiwanda. Je, chakula hicho kinatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Inategemea. Chakula kinachotolewa kwenye chumba cha chakula cha kampuni (canteen) kwa wafanyakazi wote kwa bei ya chini au bure kawaida halionekani kama mapato yanayotozwa kodi. Lakini ikiwa kampuni inalipia chakula cha mfanyakazi mmoja mmoja kwenye mgahawa au kutoa posho ya chakula ya pesa — inajumuishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira na inatozwa PAYE. Kwa ufafanuzi zaidi wa hali yako mahususi, thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa TRA.
answer_en: It depends. Meals provided in a company canteen available to all employees at a subsidized or free rate are generally not treated as taxable income. However, if the company pays for individual meals at a restaurant or provides a cash meal allowance — this is included in employment income and is subject to PAYE. For clarity on your specific situation, confirm with a TRA-registered tax consultant.
question_en: A company pays for an employee's daily lunch at the factory. Is that meal subject to PAYE?
next_review_trigger: TRA circular on benefits in kind

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana hisa za kampuni anayofanyia kazi. Anapopata hisa au dividendi — anatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hisa zinazotolewa kama sehemu ya fidia ya ajira (employee share scheme) zinatozwa PAYE kwa thamani ya soko wakati wa kupewa. Dividendi zinazolipwa kwa hisa hizo baadaye zinatozwa kodi ya kizuizi ya 5% (kwa wakazi wa Tanzania) — si PAYE. Kwa mipango tata ya hisa au options, thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi — muda na thamani ya utozaji unaweza kutofautiana. Rekodi sahihi za thamani ya hisa ni muhimu.
answer_en: Shares granted as part of employment compensation (employee share scheme) are subject to PAYE at market value at the time of grant. Dividends paid on those shares subsequently are subject to 5% withholding tax (for Tanzania residents) — not PAYE. For complex share schemes or options, confirm with a tax consultant — the timing and value of taxation can vary. Accurate records of share values are essential.
question_en: An employee holds shares in the company they work for. When they receive shares or dividends — are they subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — share schemes and dividends

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya mapato ya kampuni (corporate income tax) Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kawaida cha kodi ya mapato ya kampuni Tanzania ni asilimia 30 ya faida inayotozwa kodi. Kampuni zilizoorodheshwa kwenye Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) zinapata kiwango cha pungufu cha asilimia 25. Kampuni ndogo zinazofanya biashara kwa njia ya mfumo wa kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax) zinalipa kwa njia tofauti kulingana na mapato. Kiwango hiki kinaweza kubadilika kufuatia Sheria ya Fedha ya kila mwaka.
answer_en: The standard corporate income tax rate in Tanzania is 30% of taxable profit. Companies listed on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) benefit from a reduced rate of 25%. Small businesses operating under the presumptive tax system pay at different rates based on turnover. This rate may change following each annual Finance Act.
question_en: What is the corporate income tax rate in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — Income Tax Act Cap.332

question_sw: Muda wa mwisho wa kuwasilisha return ya kodi ya mapato ya kampuni TRA ni lini?
answer_sw: Kampuni lazima iwasilishe return ya kodi ya mapato ndani ya miezi sita (6) baada ya mwisho wa mwaka wa fedha. Kwa kampuni nyingi zinazomaliza mwaka wa fedha Desemba 31, tarehe ya mwisho ni Juni 30 ya mwaka unaofuata. Ikiwa mwaka wa fedha unaishia tarehe nyingine, hesabu miezi 6 kutoka tarehe hiyo. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha return kunasababisha adhabu na riba.
answer_en: A company must file its income tax return within six (6) months after the end of the financial year. For companies with a December 31 year end, the deadline is 30 June of the following year. If the financial year ends on a different date, count 6 months from that date. Late filing attracts penalties and interest.
question_en: What is the deadline for filing a company income tax return with TRA?

question_sw: Kodi ya awali (provisional tax) ni nini na kampuni inalipaje?
answer_sw: Kodi ya awali ni malipo ya mapema ya kodi ya mapato yanayofanywa wakati wa mwaka wa fedha kabla return ya mwisho haijafungwa. Kampuni inalipa kwa awamu nne: awamu ya kwanza ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 3 wa mwaka wa fedha, ya pili ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 6, ya tatu ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 9, na ya nne ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 12. Kila awamu ni sawa na robo ya kodi inayokadiriwa ya mwaka. Tofauti kati ya kodi ya awali iliyolipwa na kodi halisi ya mwaka inalipwa au kurudishwa wakati return ya mwisho inawasilishwa.
answer_en: Provisional tax is an advance payment of income tax made during the financial year before the final return is filed. A company pays in four instalments: first instalment by the end of month 3 of the financial year, second by end of month 6, third by end of month 9, and fourth by end of month 12. Each instalment equals approximately one quarter of the estimated annual tax. The difference between provisional tax paid and the actual annual tax is settled or refunded when the final return is filed.
question_en: What is provisional tax and how does a company pay it?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — provisional tax instalments

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inapokea dividendi kutoka kampuni nyingine ya Tanzania. Je, dividendi hiyo inatozwa kodi ya kampuni?
answer_sw: Dividendi zinazolipwa kati ya kampuni za Tanzania zinazohusika zinalipwa kwa kodi ya kizuizi (withholding tax) ya asilimia 5 wakati zinalipwa — hii inalipwa na kampuni inayolipa dividendi. Mpokeaji wa dividendi (kampuni nyingine ya Tanzania) haijumuishi dividendi hii kwenye mapato yake yanayotozwa kodi ya kampuni, kwa sababu kodi ya kizuizi inamaliza wajibu wa kodi kwa dividendi hiyo.
answer_en: Dividends paid between resident Tanzanian companies are subject to 5% withholding tax at the time of payment — paid by the company paying the dividend. The recipient company (another Tanzanian company) does not include this dividend in its corporate income tax base, because the withholding tax constitutes full and final settlement of the tax liability on that dividend.
question_en: A Tanzanian company receives dividends from another Tanzanian company. Is that dividend subject to corporate income tax?

question_sw: Gharama zipi za biashara zinaweza kukatwa (deductible) wakati wa kuhesabu kodi ya mapato ya kampuni?
answer_sw: Gharama zinazoweza kukatwa ni zile zilizotumika kabisa na kipekee kwa ajili ya biashara, zikiwa ni pamoja na: mishahara ya wafanyakazi, kodi ya nyumba ya ofisi au kiwanda, malipo ya mkopo ya biashara (riba), gharama za umeme na maji, gharama za masoko na utangazaji, na uchakavu wa mali (depreciation kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa kisheria). Gharama ambazo haziwezi kukatwa ni pamoja na: faini za kisheria, gharama za kibinafsi za mmiliki, malipo ya kampuni zinazohusiana zaidi ya thamani ya soko, na hongo.
answer_en: Deductible expenses are those incurred wholly and exclusively for business purposes, including: employee salaries, office or factory rent, business loan interest, electricity and water costs, marketing and advertising expenses, and asset depreciation (at prescribed rates). Non-deductible expenses include: legal fines and penalties, personal expenses of the owner, above-market payments to related parties, and bribes.
question_en: Which business expenses can be deducted when calculating corporate income tax?

question_sw: Kampuni inanunua mashine ya TZS 50,000,000. Gharama ya mashine hiyo inakatwa kwa mwaka mmoja au inagawanywa miaka mingi?
answer_sw: Gharama ya mashine haiwezi kukatwa yote kwa mwaka mmoja. Inagawanywa kwa njia ya uchakavu (depreciation) kulingana na kiwango kilichoandikwa na TRA kulingana na darasa la mali. Kwa mfano, mashine za viwandani mara nyingi zinaangukia darasa la 37.5% kwa njia ya kufuta kwa msingi unaopungua (reducing balance method). Kiwango sahihi kinategemea aina ya mali. TRA inachapisha jedwali la madarasa ya mali na viwango vyake.
answer_en: The cost of machinery cannot be deducted entirely in one year. It is spread over multiple years through depreciation at rates prescribed by TRA according to the asset class. For example, industrial machinery typically falls in the 37.5% class under the reducing balance method. The exact rate depends on the asset type. TRA publishes a schedule of asset classes and their rates.
question_en: A company purchases machinery for TZS 50,000,000. Is the cost of the machinery deducted in one year or spread over many years?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to depreciation rates

question_sw: Kampuni inapata hasara ya TZS 20,000,000 mwaka huu. Je, hasara hiyo inaweza kubebwa mbele na kupunguza kodi ya miaka ijayo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Hasara ya biashara inayothibitishwa na TRA inaweza kubebwa mbele na kutumiwa kupunguza mapato yanayotozwa kodi ya miaka ijayo. Hata hivyo, kuna kikomo cha muda: hasara inaweza kubebwa mbele kwa kipindi fulani tu kulingana na Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato — thibitisha muda halisi wa sasa na TRA au mshauri wa kodi kwa sababu kanuni hii inapitiwa mara kwa mara. Tangu Finance Act 2024: baada ya miaka 4 mfululizo ya hasara, asilimia 60 tu ya mapato ya mwaka wa 5 inaweza kutumika kupunguza hasara zilizobebwa mbele (ilipungua kutoka asilimia 70). Hasara haiwezi kubebwa nyuma (carry back) nchini Tanzania.
answer_en: Yes. A business loss confirmed by TRA can be carried forward and used to reduce taxable income in future years. However, there is a time limit: losses can only be carried forward for a specific period under the Income Tax Act — confirm the current period with TRA or a tax consultant as this rule is reviewed periodically. Since Finance Act 2024: after 4 consecutive loss years, only 60% of year 5 income can be offset against carried forward losses (reduced from 70%). Losses cannot be carried back in Tanzania.
question_en: A company incurs a loss of TZS 20,000,000 this year. Can that loss be carried forward to reduce tax in future years?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — loss carry forward

question_sw: Kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax) ni nini na biashara gani zinaistahili?
answer_sw: Kodi ya makisio ni mfumo wa kodi uliorahisishwa kwa biashara ndogo ambazo hazihitajiki kutunza vitabu kamili vya uhasibu. Biashara zinazostahili ni zile zenye mapato ya mwaka kati ya TZS 4,000,000 na TZS 100,000,000. Kodi inalipwa kulingana na jedwali la kiwango kilichowekwa awali kulingana na aina ya biashara na eneo — si kwa faida halisi. Biashara zenye mapato zaidi ya TZS 100,000,000 lazima zitumie mfumo wa kawaida wa uhasibu na kodi ya mapato ya kampuni.
answer_en: Presumptive tax is a simplified tax regime for small businesses that are not required to maintain full accounting records. Eligible businesses are those with annual turnover between TZS 4,000,000 and TZS 100,000,000. Tax is paid according to a predetermined rate schedule based on business type and location — not on actual profit. Businesses with turnover above TZS 100,000,000 must use the normal accounting system and corporate income tax.
question_en: What is presumptive tax and which businesses qualify for it?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — presumptive tax regime

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya PAYE na kodi ya mapato ya kampuni ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) ni kodi inayokatwa na mwajiri kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kila mwezi na kuiwasilisha TRA. Ni kodi ya mfanyakazi, si mwajiri. Kodi ya mapato ya kampuni ni kodi inayolipwa na kampuni yenyewe kwenye faida yake baada ya kutoa gharama zinazoruhusiwa. Kampuni inaweza kulipa PAYE kwa niaba ya wafanyakazi wake NA kulipa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwenye faida yake — hizi ni wajibu tofauti mbili.
answer_en: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) is tax withheld by an employer from an employee's salary each month and remitted to TRA. It is the employee's tax, not the employer's. Corporate income tax is tax paid by the company itself on its profits after allowing permitted expenses. A company may pay PAYE on behalf of its employees AND pay corporate income tax on its profits — these are two separate obligations.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and corporate income tax?

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inamilikiwa na kampuni mama ya nje. Sheria ya kuzuia uchepushwaji wa faida (thin capitalisation) inaathiri vipi mkopo kutoka kwa kampuni mama?
answer_sw: Sheria ya udhaifu wa mtaji (thin capitalisation) Tanzania inazuia ukato wa riba inayolipwa kwa mmiliki wa nje ikiwa deni la kampuni linazidi mara tatu ya mtaji wake (uwiano wa 3:1 wa deni kwa mtaji). Riba inayolipwa kwenye deni linalozidi kikomo hiki haiwezi kukatwa kama gharama ya biashara. Kanuni hii inalenga kuzuia kampuni za kimataifa kupeleka faida nje ya Tanzania kwa njia ya mikopo ya bandia yenye riba kubwa. Thibitisha muundo wako wa fedha na mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: Tanzania's thin capitalisation rules limit the deductibility of interest paid to a foreign parent company if the company's debt exceeds three times its equity (3:1 debt-to-equity ratio). Interest on debt exceeding this limit cannot be deducted as a business expense. This rule is designed to prevent multinational companies from shifting profits out of Tanzania through artificial high-interest loans. Confirm your financing structure with a tax consultant.
question_en: A Tanzanian company is owned by a foreign parent. How does the thin capitalisation rule affect loans from the parent company?

question_sw: Mtu mmoja ana nyumba za kupangisha na anapata kodi ya TZS 2,000,000 kwa mwezi. Atalipa kodi ya mapato vipi?
answer_sw: Mapato ya kodi ya nyumba (rental income) yanapaswa kutangazwa kwenye return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi kila mwaka. Kiwango cha kodi ya makisio kwa mapato ya kodi ni asilimia 15 ya mapato ghafi ya kodi bila gharama kukatwa — hii ni kodi ya mwisho (final withholding). Kama mpangaji ni shirika au biashara iliyosajiliwa, lazima wakatae kodi ya kizuizi ya 15% wakati wanapomlipia mwenye nyumba na kuiwasilisha TRA. Mwenye nyumba binafsi lazima aandikishe mapato hayo kwenye TIN na system ya TRA.
answer_en: Rental income must be declared in the individual income tax return each year. The withholding tax rate on rental income is 15% of gross rental receipts without deducting expenses — this is a final tax. If the tenant is a registered company or business, they must withhold 15% at the time of paying the landlord and remit it to TRA. The individual landlord must register this income with their TIN in the TRA system.
question_en: An individual owns rental properties and receives rent of TZS 2,000,000 per month. How do they pay income tax?

question_sw: Benki inalipa riba ya TZS 500,000 kwa akaunti ya akiba ya mteja. Je, riba hiyo inatozwa kodi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Riba inayolipwa na benki kwa akaunti za akiba ya wakazi wa Tanzania inatozwa kodi ya kizuizi ya asilimia 10. Benki inakataa kodi hii moja kwa moja na kuiwasilisha TRA kabla mteja hajapata riba yake halisi. Hii ni kodi ya mwisho kwa watu binafsi — hawahitajiki kutangaza riba hii kwenye return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi. Kwa makampuni, riba ya benki inaweza kujumuishwa kwenye mapato ya biashara yanayotozwa kodi ya kawaida.
answer_en: Yes. Interest paid by a bank on savings accounts for Tanzanian residents is subject to 10% withholding tax. The bank deducts this tax directly and remits it to TRA before the customer receives their net interest. This is a final tax for individuals — they do not need to declare this interest in an individual income tax return. For companies, bank interest may be included in business income subject to normal corporate tax.
question_en: A bank pays interest of TZS 500,000 on a customer's savings account. Is that interest subject to tax?

question_sw: Kampuni ya uwekezaji iliyoidhinishwa (TIC) inapata msamaha wa kodi. Je, msamaha huo unaweza kudumishwa daima?
answer_sw: Hapana. Misamaha ya kodi inayotolewa na Kituo cha Uwekezaji Tanzania (TIC) chini ya Sheria ya Uwekezaji wa Tanzania ina kipindi maalum cha miaka kadhaa. Kampuni lazima itimize masharti ya uwekezaji (kama vile mimi wa uwekezaji, idadi ya wafanyakazi, na sekta) kudumisha msamaha. Msamaha unaweza kuondolewa ikiwa masharti hayatimizwi au mwaka wake unaisha bila kuhuishwa. Angalia hati yako ya usajili wa TIC kwa masharti mahususi na muda.
answer_en: No. Tax incentives granted by the Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) under the Tanzania Investment Act have a specific period of several years. The company must meet investment conditions (such as investment amount, employee numbers, and sector) to maintain the exemption. The exemption may be withdrawn if conditions are not met or its term expires without renewal. Review your TIC registration certificate for specific conditions and duration.
question_en: A TIC-approved investment company receives a tax exemption. Can that exemption be maintained permanently?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — TIC investment incentives
next_review_trigger: TIC incentive policy change or Investment Act amendment

question_sw: Kodi ya chini ya lazima (alternative minimum tax) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Tanzania ina mfumo wa kodi ya chini ya lazima (AMT) ambao unaweza kutumika kwa kampuni ambazo zinadai hasara au vikato vingi vya kodi na hazilipaji kodi yoyote kwa miaka mingi. Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, kampuni zinazopata mapato ghafi ya zaidi ya kiasi fulani lakini zinadai kutolipa kodi zinaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kiwango cha chini. Maelezo kamili ya mfumo huu na vizingiti vyake thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa TRA kwa sababu kanuni zinaweza kubadilika.
answer_en: Tanzania has an alternative minimum tax (AMT) mechanism that may apply to companies claiming losses or large deductions and paying no tax for many years. Under the Income Tax Act, companies earning above a certain gross income but claiming zero tax liability may be required to pay a minimum amount. For full details on this mechanism and its thresholds, confirm with a TRA-registered tax consultant as the rules may change.
question_en: What is the alternative minimum tax in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — alternative minimum tax

question_sw: Kampuni inalijaza return ya kodi ya mapato kwenye mfumo gani wa TRA?
answer_sw: Kampuni inawasilisha return ya kodi ya mapato kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa TRA unaojulikana kama IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) au mfumo wake wa kibinafsi wa TRA e-filing. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyosajiliwa na akaunti ya IDRAS. Baada ya kujaza return mtandaoni, malipo yanafanywa kupitia GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) — benki au simu za pesa zinazoungana na mfumo huu. Epuka kuwasilisha kwa karatasi kwa sababu TRA inasisitiza e-filing.
answer_en: A company submits its income tax return through TRA's online system known as IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) or TRA's own e-filing platform. The company must have a registered TIN and an IDRAS account. After completing the online return, payment is made via GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) — banks or mobile money services connected to this system. Avoid paper filing as TRA emphasises e-filing.
question_en: Through which TRA system does a company file its income tax return?

question_sw: Nini tofauti kati ya usajili wa biashara BRELA na leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inasajili biashara kisheria — yaani inazipa hadhi ya kisheria ya kufanya biashara Tanzania kama kampuni au jina la biashara. Leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa (LGA) ni ruhusa ya kufanya shughuli mahususi katika eneo la mtaa fulani — inatolewa na Halmashauri husika. Biashara nyingi zinahitaji ZOTE mbili: usajili wa BRELA kwanza, kisha leseni ya LGA ya eneo unakofanya biashara. Ni wajibu tofauti mbili za kisheria.
answer_en: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) legally registers a business — giving it a legal identity to operate in Tanzania as a company or business name. The Local Government Authority (LGA) business licence is a permit to conduct specific activities in a particular area — issued by the relevant council. Most businesses need BOTH: BRELA registration first, then an LGA licence for the area where they operate. They are two separate legal obligations.
question_en: What is the difference between BRELA business registration and a local government business licence?
primary_source_name: BRELA — business registration vs LGA licensing

question_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa inatoka kwa nani na inahusu nini hasa?
answer_sw: Leseni ya biashara inatolewa na Halmashauri ya Manispaa, Mji, au Wilaya (LGA) ambapo biashara inafanywa. Inaidhinisha aina ya shughuli za biashara zinazoruhusiwa, idadi ya watumishi, na eneo. Inahitajika kwa biashara zote zinazofanya kazi katika Tanzania Bara, ikiwa ni pamoja na maduka, migahawa, ofisi za ushauri, na biashara za mitaani. Leseni inahitajika kuhuishwa kila mwaka — kawaida ifikapo Januari 31.
answer_en: A business licence is issued by the Municipal, Town, or District Council (LGA) where the business operates. It authorises the specific types of business activities permitted, number of employees, and location. It is required for all businesses operating in Tanzania Mainland, including shops, restaurants, consulting offices, and street vendors. The licence must be renewed annually — usually by 31 January.
question_en: Who issues a local government business licence and what specifically does it cover?

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa biashara inayofanya kazi bila leseni ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: Kufanya biashara bila leseni ya LGA ni kosa la kisheria nchini Tanzania. Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: faini za pesa, kufungwa kwa biashara hadi leseni ipatikane, na hata mashtaka ya jinai dhidi ya mmiliki wa biashara. Mwanzo kawaida ni onyo na faini la awali, lakini ufuatiliaji unaweza kusababisha kufungwa kwa biashara. Halmashauri nyingi zina maafisa wa ukaguzi wanaosafiri mara kwa mara kuangalia leseni. Usijaribu kufanya biashara bila leseni — gharama ya leseni ni ndogo ukilinganisha na adhabu.
answer_en: Operating a business without an LGA licence is a criminal offence in Tanzania. Penalties may include: monetary fines, closure of the business until a licence is obtained, and even criminal prosecution of the business owner. The initial response is typically a warning and an initial fine, but continued non-compliance can lead to business closure. Many councils have inspection officers who patrol regularly to check licences. Do not attempt to operate without a licence — the licence cost is small compared to the penalties.
question_en: What penalty applies to a business operating without a local government licence?

question_sw: Mgahawa wangu unahitaji leseni maalum zaidi ya leseni ya kawaida ya LGA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mgahawa na biashara za chakula zinahitaji leseni maalum za ziada, ambazo ni pamoja na: leseni ya chakula (food handling certificate) kutoka kwa Mamlaka ya Chakula na Dawa Tanzania (TMDA), cheti cha afya (health certificate) cha watumishi wote wanaoshughulikia chakula, ukaguzi wa mazingira na usafi wa mazingira (environmental health inspection) kutoka Halmashauri, na wakati mwingine leseni ya biashara ya vinywaji. Ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara hufanywa na maafisa wa afya wa Halmashauri.
answer_en: Yes. Restaurants and food businesses require additional special licences beyond the standard LGA licence, including: a food handling certificate from the Tanzania Food and Drugs Authority (TMDA), health certificates for all food handlers, an environmental and public health inspection from the Council, and sometimes a beverages business licence. Regular inspections are carried out by council health officers.
question_en: Does my restaurant need additional licences beyond the standard LGA licence?
next_review_trigger: TMDA Act amendment or LGA licence category change

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya uuzaji wa pombe inahitaji nini zaidi ya leseni ya LGA?
answer_sw: Uuzaji wa pombe (mvinyo, bia, na vinywaji vikali) unahitaji leseni maalum ya vinywaji vikali (liquor licence) inayotolewa na Halmashauri husika. Tanzania ina kanuni kali za usalama wa vinywaji: uuzaji kwa watoto chini ya miaka 18 ni kosa la jinai. Muda wa kufungua duka la pombe pia udhibitiwa na Halmashauri. Zaidi ya hayo, biashara za kutengeneza pombe (breweries) zinahitaji leseni za ziada kutoka TRA (excise duty registration) na TMDA. Nenda Halmashauri yako kwa fomu za leseni ya vinywaji.
answer_en: Selling alcohol (wine, beer, and spirits) requires a special liquor licence issued by the relevant Council. Tanzania has strict alcohol safety regulations: selling to children under 18 is a criminal offence. Opening hours for alcohol outlets are also regulated by the Council. Additionally, businesses manufacturing alcohol (breweries) require additional licences from TRA (excise duty registration) and TMDA. Go to your Council for liquor licence application forms.
question_en: My alcohol sales business needs what beyond the standard LGA licence?
next_review_trigger: Liquor Act or LGA regulation amendment

question_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa (money transfer) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa inahitaji leseni ya maalum kutoka Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) chini ya Sheria ya Huduma za Malipo ya Mwaka 2015. Hii ni pamoja na: wakala wa kampuni kubwa ya pesa kama M-Pesa au Airtel Money (wanayohitaji idhini ya kampuni mama), au mwenye leseni wa kujitegemea wa huduma za malipo. Leseni za BoT ni za aina nyingi — thibitisha aina ya huduma unayotaka kutoa. GN 487A (Julai 2025) pia inapiga marufuku raia wasio Watanzania kufanya biashara ya kuhamisha pesa.
answer_en: A money transfer business requires a special licence from the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) under the Payment Services Act 2015. This includes: being an agent of a large money company like M-Pesa or Airtel Money (requiring parent company authorisation), or being an independent licensed payment service provider. BoT licences come in multiple categories — confirm the type of service you wish to provide. GN 487A (July 2025) also prohibits non-Tanzanian citizens from conducting money transfer business.
question_en: What licence does a money transfer business need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: BoT Payment Services Act amendment or GN 487A revision

question_sw: Biashara ya utalii (tour operator) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya utalii inahitaji leseni ya mwendeshaji wa utalii (tour operator licence) kutoka Bodi ya Utalii Tanzania (TTB — Tanzania Tourist Board). Pia inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA kama kampuni au jina la biashara, leseni ya LGA ya halmashauri husika, na TIN/VAT ikiwa mapato yanazidi kizingiti. Kwa safari za mwituni (wildlife safaris), leseni ya ziada kutoka TAWA (Tanzania Wildlife Authority) inaweza kuhitajika. Leseni ya TTB inahuishwa kila mwaka na inahitaji uthibitisho wa uwezo wa kifedha na kitaaluma.
answer_en: A tourism business requires a tour operator licence from the Tanzania Tourist Board (TTB). It also requires: BRELA registration as a company or business name, an LGA licence from the relevant council, and TIN/VAT if income exceeds the threshold. For wildlife safaris, an additional licence from TAWA (Tanzania Wildlife Authority) may be required. The TTB licence is renewed annually and requires proof of financial and professional capacity.
question_en: What licence does a tourism business (tour operator) need in Tanzania?

question_sw: Kampuni ya ujenzi inahitaji leseni gani kabla ya kuanza kuchukua mikataba ya ujenzi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya ujenzi lazima iandikishwe na Bodi ya Usajili wa Wakandarasi (CRB — Contractors Registration Board) chini ya Wizara ya Ujenzi. CRB ina madarasa ya usajili (darasa A hadi G) kulingana na uwezo wa fedha na uzoefu wa kampuni. Mkataba wa ujenzi unaozidi kiwango cha darasa la kampuni hauwezi kukubaliwa kisheria. Pia inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA, leseni ya LGA, TIN, na wakati mwingine vibali vya mazingira. Usajili wa CRB unahuishwa kila mwaka.
answer_en: A construction company must register with the Contractors Registration Board (CRB) under the Ministry of Works. CRB has registration classes (Class A through G) based on the company's financial capacity and experience. A construction contract exceeding the company's class limit cannot be legally accepted. Also required: BRELA registration, LGA licence, TIN, and sometimes environmental permits. CRB registration is renewed annually.
question_en: What licence does a construction company need before taking on construction contracts?

question_sw: Kampuni ya dawa au kliniki ya kibinafsi inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kliniki ya kibinafsi na duka la dawa vinahitaji: idhini ya kufungua (facility licence) kutoka Wizara ya Afya au Bodi ya Madawa Tanzania (Medical Council of Tanganyika), usajili wa daktari/mfamasia kutoka Baraza la Madawa (MCT) au Baraza la Wauguzi, leseni ya TMDA kwa biashara za dawa, leseni ya LGA ya halmashauri husika, na usajili wa BRELA. Ukaguzi wa TMDA hufanywa kabla ya kufungua na mara kwa mara baada ya kufungua. Kufungua bila idhini ni kosa zito la jinai.
answer_en: A private clinic and pharmacy require: a facility operating licence from the Ministry of Health or Medical Council of Tanganyika (MCT), individual registration of the doctor/pharmacist from MCT or Nursing Council, a TMDA licence for pharmaceutical businesses, an LGA licence from the relevant council, and BRELA registration. TMDA inspection is conducted before opening and periodically thereafter. Opening without authorisation is a serious criminal offence.
question_en: What licence does a pharmaceutical company or private clinic need in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TMDA + MCT + BRELA — medical facility licensing

question_sw: Nnataka kuingiza bidhaa kutoka nje ya nchi na kuzisambaza Tanzania. Ninahitaji leseni ya uingizaji bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uingizaji wa bidhaa Tanzania unahitaji: TIN iliyosajiliwa na TRA, nambari ya msimbo wa biashara (TIN-based importer code) kutoka TRA, na wakati mwingine leseni maalum ya bidhaa fulani — kwa mfano, dawa (TMDA), chakula (TMDA), silaha (Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani). Bidhaa zote zinazoingia Tanzania zinapita forodha na zinaweza kukaguliwa. Ikiwa unaingiza zaidi ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka, ulazimishwa kusajili VAT. Angalia pia orodha ya bidhaa zilizopigwa marufuku au zinazohitaji vibali maalum.
answer_en: Yes. Importing goods to Tanzania requires: a TIN registered with TRA, an importer code (TIN-based) from TRA, and sometimes a specific product licence — for example, medicines (TMDA), food (TMDA), weapons (Ministry of Interior). All goods entering Tanzania pass through customs and may be inspected. If you import more than TZS 200,000,000 per year, VAT registration is required. Also check the list of prohibited goods or goods requiring special permits.
question_en: I want to import goods from abroad and distribute them in Tanzania. Do I need an import licence?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TMDA regulation change

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanywa mtandaoni tu — siuzi bidhaa za kimwili, ninauza huduma za kidijitali. Je, ninahitaji leseni yoyote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara za mtandaoni (online businesses) Tanzania zinahitaji usajili wa kawaida wa biashara: usajili wa BRELA kama jina la biashara au kampuni, TIN kutoka TRA, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una ofisi au anwani ya biashara. Pia, tangu Sheria ya Fedha 2022, huduma za kidijitali zinazotolewa nchini Tanzania zinatozwa Kodi ya Huduma za Kidijitali (Digital Service Tax — DST) ya asilimia 2 ya mapato ghafi. Ikiwa mapato yako yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT, lazima usajili VAT pia.
answer_en: Yes. Online businesses in Tanzania require standard business registration: BRELA registration as a business name or company, a TIN from TRA, and an LGA licence if you have an office or business address. Also, since the Finance Act 2022, digital services provided in Tanzania are subject to Digital Service Tax (DST) of 2% of gross revenue. If your income exceeds the VAT threshold, VAT registration is also required.
question_en: My business operates online only — I don't sell physical goods, just digital services. Do I need any licence?

question_sw: Faida za kufanya biashara ndani ya Eneo Maalum la Uchumi (Special Economic Zone — SEZ) Tanzania ni zipi?
answer_sw: Biashara zilizoidhinishwa kwenye SEZ Tanzania zinapata faida kadhaa: msamaha wa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwa miaka 10 ya kwanza, msamaha wa VAT na ushuru wa forodha kwenye bidhaa za uingizaji zinazotumiwa kwenye uzalishaji, msamaha wa SDL, na msamaha wa mrabaha wa ardhi. Baada ya miaka 10, kiwango cha kodi kinapungua. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Mamlaka ya Maeneo Maalum ya Uchumi Tanzania (EPZA/SEZA). Bidhaa zinazotengenezwa SEZ zinaweza kuuzwa nje ya nchi au ndani ya Tanzania (na ushuru wa forodha unaotumika kwa mauzo ya ndani).
answer_en: Businesses approved in a Tanzania SEZ receive several benefits: corporate income tax exemption for the first 10 years, VAT and customs duty exemption on imported inputs used in production, SDL exemption, and land rent exemption. After 10 years, a reduced tax rate applies. Registration is through the Tanzania Special Economic Zones Authority (EPZA/SEZA). Goods manufactured in an SEZ can be exported or sold domestically (with applicable customs duty on domestic sales).
question_en: What are the benefits of operating a business within a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: SEZ Act amendment or Finance Act

question_sw: Kampuni ya media (radio, televisheni, au gazeti) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za media Tanzania zinahitaji leseni kutoka Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano Tanzania (TCRA — Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority). Redio na televisheni zinahitaji leseni ya utangazaji (broadcasting licence) na leseni ya maudhui (content licence). Magazeti yanahitaji usajili wa chapisho (publication registration) kutoka Wizara ya Habari. Yote yanahitaji pia: usajili wa BRELA, TIN, na leseni ya LGA. Leseni ya TCRA ina ada na masharti ya kufuata kanuni za utangazaji.
answer_en: Media companies in Tanzania require a licence from the Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority (TCRA). Radio and television stations need a broadcasting licence and a content licence. Newspapers require publication registration from the Ministry of Information. All also require: BRELA registration, TIN, and an LGA licence. The TCRA licence has fees and conditions to comply with broadcasting regulations.
question_en: What licence does a media company (radio, television, or newspaper) need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: Electronic and Postal Communications Act amendment

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya kuuza bidhaa mtandaoni inatumia Jumia au platform nyingine. Je, ninahitaji leseni tofauti ya kuuza mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Hapana leseni ya ziada maalum ya mauzo ya mtandaoni peke yake. Lakini biashara yako inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA (ikiwa bado hujafanya), TIN, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una eneo la biashara. Kama mnunuzi ni biashara iliyosajiliwa na ununuzi unazidi TZS 500,000, wanalazimika kukata kodi ya kizuizi. Ikiwa mapato yako ya jumla yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200,000,000/mwaka), lazima usajili VAT na kutoa risiti za EFD au VFD kwa malipo yote.
answer_en: No special separate licence specifically for online selling alone. But your business requires: BRELA registration (if not yet done), a TIN, and an LGA licence if you have a physical business location. If the buyer is a registered business and the purchase exceeds TZS 500,000, they are required to withhold tax. If your total income exceeds the VAT threshold (TZS 200,000,000/year), you must register for VAT and issue EFD/VFD receipts for all payments.
question_en: My business sells products online through Jumia or another platform. Do I need a special online selling licence?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA e-commerce circular

question_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inahuishwa lini na ada yake inategemeana na nini?
answer_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA lazima ihuishwe kila mwaka, kawaida ifikapo tarehe 31 Januari. Kuchelewa kuhuisha kunasababisha faini za ucheleweshaji. Ada ya leseni inategemea aina ya biashara, ukubwa wake (kulingana na mapato au eneo la jengo), na halmashauri husika. Ada zinaweza kutofautiana sana kati ya halmashauri moja na nyingine. Nenda ofisi ya halmashauri yako na hati za biashara kujua ada halisi ya mwaka huu na tarehe ya mwisho ya malipo.
answer_en: The LGA business licence must be renewed annually, usually by 31 January. Late renewal attracts delay penalties. The licence fee depends on the type of business, its size (based on income or floor space), and the relevant council. Fees can vary significantly between different councils. Go to your council office with business documents to find out the exact fee for this year and the payment deadline.
question_en: When is the LGA business licence renewed and what does the fee depend on?

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu (stamp duty) ni nini na nyaraka gani zinaathirika nazo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu ni ushuru unaolipwa kwa hati maalum zinazotajwa kwenye Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu (Stamp Duty Act, Cap. 189). Hati zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu ni pamoja na: mikataba ya manunuzi ya mali isiyohamia (ardhi/nyumba), makubaliano ya kukodi (lease/tenancy agreements), uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni, makubaliano ya mikopo, hati za kuasisi ushirika, na mamlaka ya mwakilishi (power of attorney). Hati isiyopigwa stempu haiwezi kutumika kama ushahidi mahakamani.
answer_en: Stamp duty is a tax paid on specified documents listed under the Stamp Duty Act (Cap. 189). Documents requiring stamp duty include: conveyances of immovable property (land/buildings), lease and tenancy agreements, transfer of company shares, loan agreements, partnership deeds, and powers of attorney. A document without stamp duty cannot be admitted as evidence in court.
question_en: What is stamp duty and which documents are subject to it in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty — Stamp Duty Act Cap.189
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to stamp duty schedule

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni (share transfer) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa hisa ni asilimia 1 ya thamani ya hisa iliyoidhinishwa na bodi (the value of the shares as approved by the Board). Hii inatumika kwa hisa za kampuni zilizosajiliwa Tanzania, hati za deni (debentures), na faida inayohusiana na hati za amana, bima, au dhamana. Mwuzaji wa hisa kwa kawaida ndiye anayebeba wajibu wa kulipa kodi ya stempu, isipokuwa pande mbili zikubaliane vinginevyo.
answer_en: The stamp duty rate on share transfers is 1% of the value of the shares as approved by the Board. This applies to shares in Tanzanian registered companies, debentures, and interests secured by bonds, mortgage deeds, or insurance policies. The seller of the shares is typically the party bearing the stamp duty obligation unless the two parties agree otherwise.
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on a company share transfer?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — share transfer schedule

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye mkataba wa kukodi nyumba (tenancy/lease agreement) inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye mkataba wa kukodi nyumba au ardhi ni asilimia 1 ya kodi ya mwaka iliyowekwa (annual reserved rent) — hii inatumika kwa mikataba yote ya kukodi bila kujali muda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi = kodi ya mwaka TZS 6,000,000. Kodi ya stempu = 1% × 6,000,000 = TZS 60,000. Mkataba lazima upigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kutiwa saini, vinginevyo adhabu inatumika.
answer_en: Stamp duty on a tenancy or lease agreement is 1% of the annual reserved rent — this applies to all lease agreements regardless of duration. For example, rent of TZS 500,000 per month = annual rent TZS 6,000,000. Stamp duty = 1% × 6,000,000 = TZS 60,000. The agreement must be stamped within 30 days of signing, otherwise a penalty applies.
question_en: How is stamp duty on a tenancy/lease agreement calculated?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — lease schedule

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au nyumba (property transfer) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au nyumba ni asilimia 1 ya thamani ya malipo au thamani ya soko. Kwa mfano, mali inayouzwa kwa TZS 500,000,000 inalipa kodi ya stempu ya TZS 5,000,000. Zaidi ya hilo, uhamishaji wa ardhi na nyumba unaweza pia kuathiriwa na Kodi ya Faida ya Mtaji (Capital Gains Tax). Thibitisha mahesabu na mshauri wa kodi kwa miamala mikubwa ya mali isiyohamia.
answer_en: Stamp duty on transfer of land or buildings is 1% of the consideration or market value. For example, property sold for TZS 500,000,000 pays stamp duty of TZS 5,000,000. Additionally, transfer of land and buildings may also attract Capital Gains Tax. Confirm calculations with a tax consultant for large immovable property transactions.
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on a land or building transfer (property transfer)?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — property exchange schedule

question_sw: Makubaliano ya mkopo kati ya kampuni mbili yanahitaji kodi ya stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makubaliano ya mkopo (loan agreement) yanajumuishwa kwenye hati zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu. Kiwango kinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya hati: kama ni 'agreement or memorandum of agreement' ya kawaida, kodi ya stempu ni TZS 2,000. Kwa hati za pawn, hypothecation, au deposit ya hati za umiliki wa mali (title deeds), kodi ni pia TZS 2,000. Makubaliano ya mkopo lazima yapigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kutiwa saini.
answer_en: Yes. Loan agreements are included among instruments requiring stamp duty. The rate depends on the type of instrument: for a standard 'agreement or memorandum of agreement', stamp duty is TZS 2,000. For instruments of pawn, hypothecation, or deposit of title deeds, the duty is also TZS 2,000. Loan agreements must be stamped within 30 days of signing.
question_en: Does a loan agreement between two companies require stamp duty?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — agreement schedule

question_sw: Ndani ya muda gani hati lazima ipigwe stempu baada ya kutiwa saini?
answer_sw: Hati zote zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu zilizotiwa saini Tanzania lazima zipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 (thelathini) baada ya kutiwa saini. Kama hati imetiwa saini nje ya Tanzania lakini inahusiana na mali au jambo linalofanywa Tanzania, nayo lazima ipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kuingia Tanzania. Wakati wa kupeleka hati kwa Afisa wa Stempu kwa tathmini (adjudication), siku hizo hazihesabiwi kwenye siku 30.
answer_en: All instruments requiring stamp duty that are signed in Tanzania must be stamped within 30 (thirty) days of signing. If an instrument is signed outside Tanzania but relates to property or a matter performed in Tanzania, it must also be stamped within 30 days of entering Tanzania. The time period during which the instrument is lodged with the Stamp Duty Officer for adjudication is excluded from the 30-day period.
question_en: Within what period must a document be stamped after it is signed?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — 30-day rule

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa hati isiyopigwa stempu inayowasilishwa mahakamani?
answer_sw: Hati isiyopigwa stempu haiwezi kukubalika kama ushahidi mahakamani bila kwanza kulipa kodi ya stempu inayostahili pamoja na adhabu inayotozwa na Mahakama. Pia, mtu anayetumia hati isiyo na stempu kama ushahidi anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kodi ya stempu yenyewe. Zaidi ya hayo, Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu ina adhabu za jinai kwa kukwepa kwa makusudi. Daima piga stempu hati ndani ya siku 30 kuepuka matatizo makubwa mahakamani.
answer_en: A document without stamp duty cannot be admitted as evidence in court without first paying the applicable stamp duty plus a penalty imposed by the Court. Additionally, a person seeking to use an unstamped document as evidence may be ordered to pay the stamp duty themselves. Furthermore, the Stamp Duty Act carries criminal penalties for deliberate evasion. Always stamp documents within 30 days to avoid major problems in court.
question_en: What penalty applies to an unstamped document submitted as evidence in court?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — penalties for unstamped instruments

question_sw: Je, kuna msamaha wowote wa kodi ya stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kuna baadhi ya misamaha ya kodi ya stempu chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu, ikiwa ni pamoja na: hati zinazofanywa na au kwa ajili ya Serikali ya Tanzania, hati zinazohusiana na mazingira ya dharura ya umma, na hati maalum zilizoorodheshwa kwenye jedwali la msamaha wa sheria. Wakati wa shaka kuhusu kama hati yako inastahili msamaha, wasiliana na Afisa wa Stempu wa TRA au ofisi ya TRA iliyo karibu nawe.
answer_en: Yes. There are some stamp duty exemptions under the Stamp Duty Act, including: instruments made by or for the Government of Tanzania, instruments relating to public emergency circumstances, and specific instruments listed in the exemption schedule of the Act. When in doubt about whether your document qualifies for an exemption, contact the TRA Stamp Duty Officer or your nearest TRA office.
question_en: Are there any stamp duty exemptions in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — exemptions
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to stamp duty exemptions

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu inalipwa vipi kwa TRA?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) au moja kwa moja kwenye ofisi za TRA. Unaweza kulipa kupitia benki zinazoshiriki au simu za pesa zilizounganishwa na GePG. Baada ya malipo, hati inapelekwa kwa Afisa wa Stempu wa TRA ili atiwe muhuri (stamped). Unaweza pia kuwasiliana na ofisi ya TRA au kituo cha huduma za TRA kwa msaada wa mchakato.
answer_en: Stamp duty is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system or directly at TRA offices. You can pay through participating banks or mobile money services connected to GePG. After payment, the document is taken to the TRA Stamp Duty Officer for stamping. You can also contact a TRA office or TRA service centre for assistance with the process.
question_en: How is stamp duty paid to TRA?

question_sw: Wakati kampuni mpya inaandikishwa, Hati ya Kuasisi Ushirika (Memorandum of Association) inahitaji kodi ya stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Memorandum of Association ya kampuni inahitaji kodi ya stempu ya TZS 10,000 kulingana na jedwali la Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu. Hati hii lazima ipigwe stempu wakati wa usajili wa kampuni au kabla ya hapo. Kwa ushirika (partnership), ada ya kodi ya stempu inategemea mtaji wa ushirika: TZS 1,000 kama mtaji hauzidi TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 kama mtaji kati ya TZS 100,000 na TZS 1,000,000; na TZS 10,000 katika hali nyingine.
answer_en: Yes. A company's Memorandum of Association requires stamp duty of TZS 10,000 under the schedule of the Stamp Duty Act. This document must be stamped at the time of company registration or earlier. For a partnership deed, the stamp duty depends on the partnership capital: TZS 1,000 if capital does not exceed TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 if capital is between TZS 100,000 and TZS 1,000,000; and TZS 10,000 in other cases.
question_en: When a new company is registered, does the Memorandum of Association require stamp duty?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — MoA and partnership schedule

question_sw: Waajiri wa EPZ (Export Processing Zone) wanaweza kusamehewa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizosajiliwa rasmi kwenye EPZ Tanzania zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL kama sehemu ya msururu wa motisha za uwekezaji. Hata hivyo, msamaha huu si wa kiotomatiki — kampuni lazima ithibitishe hadhi yake ya EPZ na EPZA na kupata idhini maalum ya msamaha kutoka TRA. Angalia hati yako ya usajili wa EPZ kwa masharti. Ikiwa hujapata msamaha rasmi, wajibu wa SDL bado upo hadi utakapopata uthibitisho wa maandishi kutoka TRA.
answer_en: Companies formally registered in a Tanzania Export Processing Zone (EPZ) may be eligible for SDL exemption as part of the investment incentive package. However, this exemption is not automatic — the company must confirm its EPZ status with EPZA and obtain a specific exemption approval from TRA. Check your EPZ registration certificate for conditions. If you have not received formal exemption, the SDL obligation remains until you receive written confirmation from TRA.
question_en: Can employers in an Export Processing Zone (EPZ) be exempted from SDL?
next_review_trigger: EPZ Act amendment or TRA SDL circular

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuomba msamaha wa SDL vipi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayetaka msamaha wa SDL lazima aandike ombi rasmi kwa Kamishna wa TRA akitoa sababu za kisheria za msamaha, kama vile hadhi ya EPZ, hali ya shirika lisilo la faida, au msamaha mwingine uliowekwa kisheria. Ombi linapaswa kuambatanishwa na: cheti cha usajili wa shirika, hati inayothibitisha hadhi ya msamaha (k.m. cheti cha EPZA au hati ya shirika lisilo la faida), na nyaraka za BRELA. TRA itapitia ombi na kutoa uamuzi kwa maandishi. Usidai msamaha kabla ya kupata uamuzi wa TRA.
answer_en: An employer seeking SDL exemption must write a formal application to the TRA Commissioner General stating the legal grounds for exemption, such as EPZ status, non-profit organisation status, or another statutory exemption. The application should be accompanied by: the organisation's registration certificate, documentation confirming exemption status (e.g., EPZA certificate or non-profit deed), and BRELA documents. TRA will review the application and issue a written decision. Do not claim exemption before receiving TRA's written decision.
question_en: How can an employer apply for an SDL exemption?

question_sw: SDL inahesabiwaje — inatumika kwenye mshahara wa msingi peke yake au posho pia?
answer_sw: SDL inahesabiwaje kwa Tanzania inategemea tafsiri ya 'gross emoluments' ya mwajiri. Kwa ujumla, SDL ya 3.5% inahesabiwaje kwenye jumla ya fidia ya ajira inayolipwa kwa wafanyakazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na mshahara wa msingi, posho za nyumba, usafiri, chakula, na malipo mengine yanayohusiana na ajira. Hata hivyo, malipo ya gharama za biashara halisi yanayopigiwa risiti kawaida hayajumuishwi. Kwa tafsiri sahihi ya mwaka huu, wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: SDL calculation in Tanzania depends on the interpretation of 'gross emoluments' by the employer. Generally, SDL at 3.5% is calculated on the total employment compensation paid to employees, including basic salary, housing allowances, transport, meals, and other employment-related payments. However, genuine business expense reimbursements supported by receipts are typically excluded. For precise interpretation for this year, contact TRA or a tax consultant.
question_en: How is SDL calculated — does it apply to basic salary only or allowances too?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA SDL circular

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inafunza wanafunzi (apprentices) chini ya mpango wa serikali. Je, hii inaathiri wajibu wa SDL?
answer_sw: Hali ya wanafunzi wa mafunzo na SDL inategemea muundo wa mpango: ikiwa mwanafunzi analipwa posho ya mafunzo (training allowance) tu — si mshahara kamili wa ajira — posho hiyo inaweza kutolewa kwenye msingi wa SDL. Ikiwa mwanafunzi anachukuliwa kama mfanyakazi kamili na analipwa mshahara, SDL inatumika. Mipango ya mafunzo iliyoidhinishwa na serikali inaweza kuwa na masharti tofauti — thibitisha na VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na TRA kabla ya kuamua jinsi ya kuhesabu.
answer_en: The SDL treatment of apprentices depends on the programme structure: if the apprentice receives only a training allowance — not a full employment salary — that allowance may be excluded from the SDL base. If the apprentice is treated as a full employee and paid a salary, SDL applies. Government-approved training programmes may have different conditions — confirm with VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and TRA before deciding how to calculate.
question_en: My company trains apprentices under a government scheme. Does this affect the SDL obligation?
next_review_trigger: VETA Act amendment or TRA circular on apprenticeship SDL

question_sw: Shirika lisilo la faida (NGO au asasi ya kiraia) linalipa SDL?
answer_sw: NGO na asasi za kiraia zilizosajiliwa rasmi zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL — lakini si kwa kiotomatiki. Mashirika lazima yathibitishe hadhi yao ya msamaha kwa TRA kila mwaka. Ikiwa NGO inaajiri wafanyakazi na inalipa mishahara, na bado haina msamaha rasmi wa maandishi kutoka TRA, wajibu wa SDL unabaki. Mashirika yanayopokea msamaha lazima yathibitishe mwaka kwa mwaka kwamba bado yanastahili.
answer_en: NGOs and civil society organisations that are formally registered may qualify for SDL exemption — but not automatically. Organisations must confirm their exemption status with TRA annually. If an NGO employs staff and pays salaries, and does not yet have a formal written exemption from TRA, the SDL obligation remains. Organisations receiving exemption must confirm annually that they still qualify.
question_en: Does a non-profit organisation (NGO or civil society) pay SDL?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA circular

question_sw: Kampuni inayomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatal) inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — taasisi zinazomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatals) kama TANESCO, TPA, na NMB zinazolipa mishahara ya wafanyakazi zinatakiwa kulipa SDL kama mwajiri mwingine yeyote, isipokuwa zitakazokuwa zimepata msamaha maalum kutoka TRA. Waajiri wote wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi wanalipa SDL ya 3.5% ya mishahara ya jumla. Hali ya kila parastatal inaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA kwa shirika lako maalum.
answer_en: Generally yes — government-owned institutions (parastatals) such as TANESCO, TPA, and NMB that pay employee salaries are required to pay SDL like any other employer, unless they have received a specific exemption from TRA. All employers with 10 or more employees pay SDL at 3.5% of gross payroll. Each parastatal's situation may vary — confirm with TRA for your specific organisation.
question_en: Does a government-owned company (parastatal) pay SDL?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA circular

question_sw: TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa SDL vipi na wanakagua nini?
answer_sw: TRA wanaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa SDL kwa mpango au baada ya kupokea taarifa za udanganyifu. Wakati wa ukaguzi, TRA wanakagua: orodha za mishahara (payroll) kwa miaka inayopitiwa, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mishahara, return za SDL zilizowasilishwa, mikataba ya ajira, na rekodi za kuidhinisha wafanyakazi. Tofauti kati ya mishahara iliyotangazwa kwenye return za PAYE na ile ya SDL ni dalili ya tatizo. Kuhifadhi rekodi za mishahara kwa miaka 5 angalau ni lazima.
answer_en: TRA may conduct SDL audits on a planned basis or after receiving fraud reports. During an audit, TRA examines: payroll records for the years under review, bank statements showing salary payments, submitted SDL returns, employment contracts, and staff confirmation records. A discrepancy between salaries declared on PAYE returns and SDL returns is a red flag. Maintaining payroll records for at least 5 years is mandatory.
question_en: How does TRA conduct an SDL audit and what do they examine?

question_sw: Pesa za SDL zinakwenda wapi na zinatumika kwa nini?
answer_sw: Mapato ya SDL yanakusanywa na TRA na kupelekwa Hazina ya Serikali. Fedha hizo zinatumiwa kufadhili mfumo wa elimu ya ufundi na mafunzo ya ujuzi Tanzania kupitia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na vyuo vya ufundi (FDCs). Lengo ni kuimarisha ujuzi wa nguvu kazi ya Tanzania. Mwajiri hana haki ya kudai marejesho ya SDL kwa sababu mafunzo fulani yanafanywa ndani ya kampuni — hii ni wajibu wa kisheria wa kawaida.
answer_en: SDL revenue is collected by TRA and transferred to the Government Treasury. The funds are used to finance Tanzania's vocational education and skills training system through VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and technical colleges (FDCs). The goal is to strengthen the skills of Tanzania's workforce. An employer has no right to claim SDL refunds on the grounds that some training is conducted internally — this is a standard statutory obligation.
question_en: Where does SDL money go and what is it used for?

question_sw: NSSF imetoa tathmini ya michango ya ziada dhidi ya kampuni yangu ambayo naona ni makosa. Naweza kupinga vipi?
answer_sw: Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya NSSF kwa njia zifuatazo: kwanza, wasiliana na ofisi ya NSSF kwa maandishi ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini, ukitoa ushahidi wa payroll yako halisi (rekodi za mshahara, slips za malipo, na rekodi za benki). Ikiwa tathmini bado hairidhishi, unaweza kupiga rufaa kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa NSSF. Kama bado hujaridhika, uzo unaendelea hadi Mahakama ya Kazi (Labour Court). Hifadhi rekodi zote za malipo ya NSSF na mishahara kwa miaka 5 ili kujibu tathmini.
answer_en: You can dispute an NSSF assessment in these steps: first, contact the NSSF office in writing within 30 days of receiving the assessment, providing evidence of your actual payroll (salary records, payslips, and bank records). If the assessment is still unsatisfactory, you can appeal to the NSSF Director General. If still unsatisfied, the dispute proceeds to the Labour Court. Keep all NSSF payment and salary records for 5 years to respond to assessments.
question_en: NSSF has issued an excess contribution assessment against my company that I believe is wrong. How can I dispute it?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment or Labour Court rules change

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kukagua rekodi za mishahara za kampuni yangu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF ina mamlaka ya kisheria ya kukagua rekodi za mishahara (payroll inspection) za mwajiri yeyote aliyesajiliwa. Wakaguzi wa NSSF wanaweza kutembelea mahali pa biashara na kuomba: orodha za mishahara, slips za malipo, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mshahara, mikataba ya ajira, na rekodi za michango ya NSSF iliyolipwa. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kutoa nyaraka hizi kwa wakaguzi wa NSSF. Kukosa kushirikiana na ukaguzi ni kosa la kisheria.
answer_en: Yes. NSSF has the legal authority to inspect the payroll records of any registered employer. NSSF inspectors may visit the business premises and request: payroll lists, payslips, bank records of salary payments, employment contracts, and records of NSSF contributions paid. An employer has a legal obligation to provide these documents to NSSF inspectors. Failure to cooperate with an inspection is a legal offence.
question_en: Can NSSF inspect my company's payroll records?

question_sw: NSSF inachukua hatua gani dhidi ya mwajiri asiyolipa michango ya wafanyakazi?
answer_sw: NSSF ina hatua kadhaa za utekelezaji dhidi ya waajiri wasiotii: kwanza, onyo rasmi na hati ya kudai malipo. Kama malipo hayafanyiki, NSSF inaweza: kutumia kisheria ili kunyang'anya mali za mwajiri, kutoa amri ya kushikilia akaunti za benki, kupeleka kesi mahakamani ya kazi au jinai, na kutoa faini ya 5% kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji wa michango isiyolipwa. Waajiri wanaohukumiwa wanaweza pia kupoteza haki ya kupata mikataba ya serikali.
answer_en: NSSF has several enforcement steps against non-compliant employers: first, a formal warning and demand notice for payment. If payment is not made, NSSF may: use legal process to seize employer assets, issue orders to freeze bank accounts, take the matter to a labour or criminal court, and impose a 5% penalty for each month of delay on unpaid contributions. Convicted employers may also lose the right to obtain government contracts.
question_en: What action does NSSF take against an employer who does not pay employee contributions?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anawezaje kuangalia historia ya michango yake ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anaweza kuangalia historia ya michango yake ya NSSF kwa njia zifuatazo: kupitia portal ya NSSF mtandaoni kwenye nssf.go.tz kwa kutumia nambari yake ya uanachama, kutembelea ofisi yoyote ya NSSF na kadi ya utambulisho, au kupiga simu ya huduma kwa wateja wa NSSF. Kauli ya michango (contribution statement) inaweza kuombwa na inakuonyesha kila mchango uliofanywa na mwajiri wako. Ikiwa michango haikuingia kwenye akaunti yako ijapokuwa mwajiri anasema amelipa, piga kengele mara moja.
answer_en: An employee can check their NSSF contribution history through: the NSSF online portal at nssf.go.tz using their membership number, visiting any NSSF office with identification, or calling the NSSF customer service line. A contribution statement can be requested and shows every contribution made by your employer. If contributions are not appearing in your account despite the employer claiming to have paid, raise the issue immediately.
question_en: How can an employee check their NSSF contribution history?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu anapokea mafao ya NSSF vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu baada ya kufikia umri wa miaka 60 (au 55 kwa wafanyakazi wa uchimbaji madini) anapaswa: kuwasilisha fomu ya madai ya mafao (benefit claim form) katika ofisi yoyote ya NSSF, kuambatanisha hati za utambulisho, barua ya kuthibitisha kustaafu kutoka kwa mwajiri, na cheti cha kuzaliwa. NSSF itatathmini miaka ya uchangiaji (minimum 180 months/miaka 15 kwa mafao kamili). Malipo yanafanywa kupitia akaunti ya benki. Kwa staafu wa kabla ya wakati, thibitisha masharti na NSSF.
answer_en: An employee retiring at age 60 (or 55 for mining sector employees) must: submit a benefit claim form at any NSSF office, attach identification documents, a retirement confirmation letter from the employer, and a birth certificate. NSSF will assess the contribution years (minimum 180 months/15 years for full benefits). Payment is made via bank account. For early retirement, confirm conditions with NSSF.
question_en: How does a retiring employee receive their NSSF pension benefits?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment to retirement age or benefit calculation

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi anaweza kuondoa mchangoa wake wa NSSF kabla ya kustaafu?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla hapana — michango ya NSSF haiwezi kuondolewa kabla ya kustaafu. Hata hivyo, kuna hali chache za kisheria ambazo zinaweza kuruhusu madai kabla ya wakati: kuwa na ulemavu mkubwa wa kudumu (permanent total disability), kifo cha mwanachama (ambapo mzigo unalipwa kwa wategemezi), au kuacha Tanzania kwa muda wa kudumu. Madai ya kawaida ya uchovu, msongo wa maisha, au tatizo la fedha hayatoi haki ya kuondoa kabla ya wakati. NSSF ni mfumo wa akiba ya muda mrefu — si akaunti ya benki inayoweza kufunguliwa wakati wowote.
answer_en: Generally no — NSSF contributions cannot be withdrawn before retirement. However, there are a few statutory circumstances that may allow early claims: permanent total disability, death of the member (in which case a survivor benefit is paid), or permanently leaving Tanzania. Ordinary claims of financial hardship, life pressures, or personal financial problems do not give a right to early withdrawal. NSSF is a long-term savings system — not a bank account that can be accessed at any time.
question_en: Can an employee withdraw their NSSF contributions before retirement?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anafariki kabla ya kustaafu. Familia yake inapata mafao gani ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Familia ya mfanyakazi aliyefariki inastahili mafao ya maisha (survivor benefits) kutoka NSSF. Wategemezi wa kisheria (mke/mume, watoto chini ya miaka 18, na wazazi wanaotegemea) wanaweza kudai: mafao ya kifo (death grant) — malipo ya mara moja — na mafao ya urithi (survivors pension) kwa wategemezi. Kuomba mafao haya, familia inapaswa: kwenda ofisi ya NSSF na cheti cha kifo, hati za utambulisho wa wategemezi, cheti cha ndoa, na cheti cha kuzaliwa kwa watoto. Madai lazima yafanyike ndani ya muda maalum.
answer_en: The family of a deceased employee is entitled to survivor benefits from NSSF. Legal dependants (spouse, children under 18, and dependent parents) may claim: a death grant (lump sum payment) and a survivor's pension for dependants. To claim these benefits, the family must: go to an NSSF office with a death certificate, identification documents of dependants, a marriage certificate, and birth certificates of children. Claims must be made within a specific time period.
question_en: An employee dies before retirement. What NSSF benefits does their family receive?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment to survivor benefits

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anabadilisha kazi kutoka kampuni A hadi kampuni B. Michango yake ya NSSF inahamia vipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya NSSF haihitajiki 'kuhamia' — inabaki kwenye akaunti ya NSSF ya mwanachama na inaendelea kujengwa bila kujali mabadiliko ya mwajiri. Nambari ya NSSF ya mwanachama inabaki ile ile, na mwajiri mpya anaendelea kuchangia kwenye nambari hiyo ile. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kumwarifu mwajiri mpya nambari yake ya NSSF mara anapokuwa ameajiriwa. Kama mwajiri mpya hajui nambari yako ya NSSF, unaweza kuomba nambari kutoka ofisi yoyote ya NSSF au kwa kutumia portal ya mtandaoni.
answer_en: NSSF contributions do not need to 'transfer' — they remain in the member's NSSF account and continue to accumulate regardless of employer changes. The member's NSSF number stays the same, and the new employer continues contributing to that same number. The employee should inform the new employer of their NSSF number when they start work. If the new employer does not know your NSSF number, you can request it from any NSSF office or through the online portal.
question_en: An employee changes jobs from Company A to Company B. How do their NSSF contributions transfer?

question_sw: Kampuni inabadilisha mkurugenzi wake (director). Mchakato wa BRELA ni upi?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha mkurugenzi wa kampuni kunahitaji: uamuzi wa bodi (board resolution) ukimteua mkurugenzi mpya na kumalizia mamlaka ya mkurugenzi wa zamani, kuwasilisha Fomu 23 (Taarifa ya Mabadiliko ya Wakurugenzi) kwa BRELA ndani ya siku 14 baada ya mabadiliko (thibitisha nambari ya sasa ya fomu kupitia mfumo wa BRELA Online (brela.go.tz) kwani nambari za fomu zinaweza kubadilika), kulipa ada inayohusiana, na kuwasilisha hati za utambulisho za mkurugenzi mpya. BRELA itasasisha rekodi na kutoa uthibitisho. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha mabadiliko kunasababisha adhabu.
answer_en: Changing a company director requires: a board resolution appointing the new director and ending the authority of the outgoing director, filing Form 23 (Notice of Change of Directors) with BRELA within 14 days of the change (confirm current form number via BRELA Online at brela.go.tz as form numbers may have changed), paying the associated fee, and submitting identification documents of the new director. BRELA will update the records and issue confirmation. Late filing of changes attracts penalties.
question_en: A company is changing its director. What is the BRELA process?

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kubadilisha jina lake. Inafuata mchakato gani wa BRELA?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha jina la kampuni kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum (special resolution) la wanahisa wenye asilimia 75 ya kura kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya jina, kuomba kuidhinishwa kwa jina jipya na BRELA kwa ajili ya uthibitisho wa upatikanaji, kuwasilisha maombi rasmi ya mabadiliko ya jina kwa BRELA na ada, na kupata cheti kipya cha usajili kikiwa na jina jipya. Baada ya mabadiliko ya jina, lazima usasishe nyaraka zote za kisheria, akaunti za benki, na leseni nyingine zote.
answer_en: Changing a company name requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders holding at least 75% of votes supporting the name change, applying to BRELA to approve the new name for availability confirmation, submitting a formal name change application to BRELA with fees, and receiving a new registration certificate with the new name. After the name change, you must update all legal documents, bank accounts, and all other licences.
question_en: A company wants to change its name. What BRELA process does it follow?

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kuongeza mtaji wake wa hisa (share capital). Inafanyaje?
answer_sw: Kuongeza mtaji wa hisa kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio la kawaida (ordinary resolution) la wanahisa, kuwasilisha fomu ya taarifa ya mabadiliko ya mtaji kwa BRELA ndani ya muda uliowekwa, kulipa ada ya usajili inayohusiana na ongezeko la mtaji, na kusasisha Hati ya Muundo wa Kampuni (Memorandum and Articles of Association) ikiwa inahitajika. BRELA itasasisha rekodi za kampuni. Ongezeko la mtaji linaweza pia kuathiri uwiano wa umiliki wa wanahisa (dilution) — thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
answer_en: Increasing share capital requires: passing an ordinary resolution of shareholders, filing a capital change notification form with BRELA within the prescribed period, paying the associated registration fee based on the capital increase, and updating the Memorandum and Articles of Association if required. BRELA will update the company records. A share capital increase may also affect shareholder ownership proportions (dilution) — confirm with a legal adviser.
question_en: A company wants to increase its share capital. How does it do this?

question_sw: Mwanahisa mmoja anamuuzia mwingine hisa zake. Je, BRELA inahitaji taarifa ya uhamishaji huu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uhamishaji wa hisa kati ya wanahisa lazima uripotiwe BRELA. Mchakato ni: kuandaa hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa (instrument of transfer), kupiga stempu hati hiyo (kodi ya stempu ya 1% — ona Stamp Duty Act), kuwasilisha taarifa ya mabadiliko ya wanahisa kwa BRELA, na kusasisha daftari la wanahisa (register of members) la kampuni. BRELA itasasisha rekodi na kutoa uthibitisho wa mabadiliko ya umiliki. Bila taarifa ya BRELA, uhamishaji unaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria dhidi ya watu wa tatu.
answer_en: Yes. Transfer of shares between shareholders must be reported to BRELA. The process is: prepare an instrument of transfer, stamp the instrument (1% stamp duty — see Stamp Duty Act), file a shareholder change notification with BRELA, and update the company's register of members. BRELA will update records and issue confirmation of the ownership change. Without BRELA notification, the transfer may lack legal effect against third parties.
question_en: One shareholder sells their shares to another. Does BRELA need to be notified of this transfer?

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kufuta usajili wake (deregistration) rasmi. Mchakato wa BRELA ni upi?
answer_sw: Kufuta usajili wa kampuni kwa hiari (voluntary dissolution) kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum la wanahisa (75%+), kuteuwa msimamizi wa likwidesheni (liquidator), kulipa madeni yote ya kampuni na kukusanya madai, kuwasilisha taarifa za mwisho za uhasibu, na kuomba kufutwa kwa jina kutoka BRELA. Mahakama inaweza pia kuagiza kufutwa kwa lazima. Utaratibu huu unaweza kuchukua miezi kadhaa. Kabla ya kufuta, hakikisha TRA, NSSF, na mashirika mengine yote yamesafirishwa na madeni yalipwa.
answer_en: Voluntary company deregistration requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders (75%+), appointing a liquidator, paying all company debts and collecting receivables, submitting final accounting statements, and applying for name removal from BRELA. A court may also order compulsory winding up. This process may take several months. Before deregistration, ensure TRA, NSSF, and all other agencies are settled and all debts are paid.
question_en: A company wants to formally deregister (dissolution). What is the BRELA process?

question_sw: Kampuni isiyofanya biashara (dormant company) bado ina wajibu wowote wa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni iliyolala (dormant company) bado ina wajibu wa kisheria wa: kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA kila mwaka, kulipa ada ya ripoti ya kila mwaka, na kudumisha mkurugenzi aliyesajiliwa na anwani ya makao makuu. Kutowasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka hata kampuni ikiwa haifanyi biashara kunasababisha faini na hatimaye kufutwa kwa jina na BRELA. Ikiwa hutaki kulipa ada hizi kila mwaka, fikiria kufuta usajili wa kampuni rasmi.
answer_en: Yes. A dormant (inactive) company still has legal obligations to: file an annual return with BRELA every year, pay the annual return fee, and maintain a registered director and registered office address. Failing to file the annual return even when the company is inactive attracts fines and eventually striking off by BRELA. If you do not want to pay these fees annually, consider formally deregistering the company.
question_en: A company that is not trading (dormant company) — does it still have any BRELA obligations?

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kusajili tawi lake (branch) Tanzania vipi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni inayotaka kusajili tawi Tanzania lazima iwasilishe kwa BRELA: hati za shirika la kampuni mama (Memorandum and Articles ya nchi ya asili), uthibitisho wa uhalali wa kampuni mama nchini yake, majina na anwani za wakurugenzi wa kampuni mama, jina la mwakilishi wa tawi Tanzania, na ada ya usajili. Tawi lazima pia lipate TIN, leseni ya LGA, na vibali vingine vinavyohusiana na biashara inayofanywa. GN 487A (Julai 2025) inazuia raia wasio Watanzania kufanya biashara fulani maalum.
answer_en: A foreign company wishing to register a branch in Tanzania must submit to BRELA: the parent company incorporation documents (Memorandum and Articles from the country of origin), proof of the parent company's legal existence in its home country, names and addresses of the parent company's directors, the name of the branch representative in Tanzania, and a registration fee. The branch must also obtain a TIN, an LGA licence, and other permits relevant to the business. GN 487A (July 2025) prohibits non-Tanzanian citizens from conducting certain specified businesses.
question_en: How can a foreign company register its branch in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: Companies Act amendment or GN 487A revision

question_sw: Ninataka kubadilisha biashara yangu ya mmiliki mmoja (sole trader) na kuifanya kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima (limited company). Ninafanyaje?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha biashara ya mmiliki mmoja kuwa kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima si 'kubadilisha' rasmi — ni kuanzisha kampuni mpya na BRELA. Mchakato ni: jaza fomu za usajili wa kampuni mpya ya kikomo cha dhima, lipa ada ya usajili, pata nambari ya TIN mpya kwa kampuni, hamisha mali na mikataba ya biashara ya zamani kwenye kampuni mpya (kwa kuzingatia mambo ya kodi na kisheria), na unaweza kuacha biashara ya mmiliki mmoja ikifunga. Pata ushauri wa mshauri wa kisheria au mhasibu kabla ya kubadilisha ili kuelewa athari za kodi.
answer_en: Converting a sole trader business to a limited company is not a formal 'conversion' — it is registering a new company with BRELA. The process is: complete new limited company registration forms with BRELA, pay the registration fee, obtain a new TIN for the company, transfer the assets and contracts of the old business to the new company (considering tax and legal implications), and you may close the sole trader business. Seek advice from a legal adviser or accountant before switching to understand the tax implications.
question_en: I want to convert my sole trader business into a limited company. How do I do this?
primary_source_name: BRELA — sole trader to limited company conversion

question_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA kwa kampuni mpya ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA zinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni na mtaji ulioandikishwa. Kwa kampuni za ndani (private/public limited companies), ada inategemea mtaji wa hisa ulioandikishwa — kampuni za mtaji mdogo (chini ya TZS 1,000,000) zinalipa ada tofauti na kampuni za mtaji mkubwa. Pia kuna ada ya usajili wa jina la biashara (business name), ushirika (partnership), na kampuni za kigeni (foreign companies). Nenda moja kwa moja kwenye tovuti ya BRELA (brela.go.tz) au ofisi ya BRELA kwa jedwali la sasa la ada kwani zinaweza kubadilika mwaka hadi mwaka.
answer_en: BRELA registration fees vary based on the type of company and registered share capital. For domestic companies (private/public limited companies), the fee depends on the registered share capital — companies with small capital (below TZS 1,000,000) pay different fees from large-capital companies. There are also fees for business name registration, partnerships, and foreign companies. Go directly to the BRELA website (brela.go.tz) or BRELA office for the current fee schedule as fees may change year to year.
question_en: What are the BRELA registration fees for a new company?

question_sw: BRELA ina portal ya mtandaoni kwa ajili ya usajili? Ninawezaje kuitumia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA ina mfumo wa usajili wa mtandaoni unaoruhusu usajili na uwasilishaji wa hati bila kuhitaji kwenda ofisi. Unaweza kufikia portal kupitia tovuti ya brela.go.tz. Hatua za kimsingi ni: tengeneza akaunti ya mtumiaji, chagua aina ya usajili unaotaka (kampuni, jina la biashara, ushirika), jaza fomu za mtandaoni, pakia hati zinazohitajika, lipa ada kupitia GePG au mfumo wa malipo ulioungwa mkono. Usajili wa mtandaoni unaokoa muda na safari. Kwa msaada wa kina, BRELA ina ofisi kuu Dar es Salaam na ofisi za kanda.
answer_en: Yes. BRELA has an online registration system that allows registration and document submission without needing to visit the office. You can access the portal through the BRELA website at brela.go.tz. The basic steps are: create a user account, select the type of registration you want (company, business name, partnership), complete the online forms, upload required documents, pay the fee via GePG or the supported payment system. Online registration saves time and travel. For detailed assistance, BRELA has its main office in Dar es Salaam and regional offices.
question_en: Does BRELA have an online portal for registration? How can I use it?

question_sw: TRA imetoa tathmini ya kodi ambayo ninaona ni makosa. Ninaweza kupinga vipi na ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: MUHIMU: Kabla ya kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi, lazima ulipe kiwango kikubwa kati ya: (a) kodi isiyobishaniwa AU (b) theluthi moja (1/3) ya kodi iliyotathminiwa — ndani ya siku 15 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Bila malipo haya hoja haitakubaliwa na TRA. Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya TRA kwa kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi rasmi (notice of objection) kwa Kamishna wa TRA ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Hoja lazima iwe kwa maandishi na ieleze kwa undani sababu za kisheria za kupingana na tathmini, ikiambatana na ushahidi wa kutosha (rekodi za uhasibu, risiti, mikataba). Kamishna atapitia hoja na kutoa uamuzi ndani ya miezi 6 kutoka tarehe ya kukubali hoja. Muhimu: Siku 30 za kuwasilisha hoja ni muda wa kisheria usiopanuliwa kwa urahisi — usipoteze muda.
